description:
**Job title**
:
*Scientific Writer – Health Economics and Value Assessment (HEVA)*

* Hiring Manager: Head/Group Lead/Team Lead HEVA
* Location: Hyderabad
* % of travel expected: Travel required as per business need
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
*Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. SGH strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.*
**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*
*Create HEVA communications deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams. Manage core HEVA communication processes, templates, and products across the portfolio. Ensure Core Value Decks for key products are established and maintained, making available a regularly updated synthesis of critical HEVA evidence on the value of products. Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication standard operating procedure (SOP) and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes. Seek opportunities to innovate HEVA value communications to increase the relevance and impact of HEVA evidence and inform optimal access and reimbursement decisions. Develop and maintain therapeutic area expertise. Manage end to end process through iEnvision (previously, Datavision/Matrix). Collaborate effectively with stakeholders: HEVA, RWE, and Scientific communication global and/or local teams.*

* People: (1) Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders (Medical scientific community) within the allocated GBU and product – with an end objective to develop education and communication content as per requirement for HEVA communications; (2) Interact effectively with healthcare professionals on publication content; and (3) Constantly assist peer writers in developing knowledge and sharing learning
* Performance: (1) Create HEVA communications deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, and slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams as per agreed timelines and quality

* Stakeholder: (1) Work closely with HEVA global and local teams, RWE global and local teams and scientific communication teams in regions/areas to identify publications needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables; and (2) Liaise with Medical, HEVA global and local teams to prepare relevant and customized deliverables

**About You**

* Experience: >2 years of experience in content creation for the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry, or academia
* Soft skills: Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment
* Technical skills: Relevant training/experience in health economics, public health, epidemiology, or other relevant health-related scientific discipline (including but not limited to therapeutic area/domain knowledge exposure; knowledge of Good Publication Practice; publication submission; and/or project management)
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree

title: Senior Business Process Engineer (Process Automation), Assistant Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a motivated process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. In this role you will support process discovery and documentation, build structured knowledge assets, and help prepare the process foundation that our automation and AI solutions are built on.
  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, eager to learn, and keen to build a career at the intersection of investment operations, process engineering and applied AI.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Support process discovery sessions, interviews and walkthroughs with subject-matter experts, capturing detailed notes and process steps accurately.
* Draft and maintain process maps, workflow documentation, business rules, exception paths and control points using approved templates and notation.
* Curate, structure and tag knowledge content — procedures, decision logic, reference material — so it can be used effectively for search, RAG and agent solutions.
* Carry out data gathering and basic analysis on volumes, effort, exceptions and rework to support opportunity assessment.
* Assist in identifying automation and AI candidates from documented processes and in preparing supporting material for intake reviews.
* Validate documented content with subject-matter experts, incorporate feedback and maintain version control and asset hygiene.
* Support testing and validation of knowledge assets, checking retrieved content for accuracy, relevance and completeness.
* Maintain the process and knowledge asset repository, ensuring content is current, correctly classified and easy to find.
* Provide regular progress updates on assigned tasks and flag issues or blockers promptly.
* Collaborate with global CoE colleagues across time zones and contribute to continuous improvement of templates and standards.

**What We Value**

* Strong attention to detail and pride in producing clear, accurate documentation.
* Willingness to learn quickly — both the Alpha domain and emerging AI and automation techniques.
* Ownership of assigned deliverables and the discipline to complete them on time.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* A collaborative, delivery-focused attitude in a global team environment.

**These Skills Will Help You Succeed In This Role**

* 8–10 years of experience in business analysis, process documentation, operations or automation/testing support, preferably within financial services.
* Understanding investment management or capital markets operations and the trade lifecycle across front, middle and back office.
* Exposure to process mapping and documentation tools (Visio, BPMN, UiPath Task Capture or equivalent).
* Awareness of automation platforms such as UiPath and of AI/GenAI concepts including RAG and knowledge structuring.
* Good analytical skills with working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to organize work, manage multiple tasks and deliver to agreed timelines.
* Flexibility to work across APAC, UK or US time zones as required.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems.
* Certifications in process excellence, automation or AI are an advantage.

**Interested but do not meet every qualification?**
If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Conference Team
description:
Global Diplomacy Forum (GDF)
  
  
​In-Person / Offline MUN Conference Roles
  
  
Role Structure: Unpaid Internship / Volunteer Base with Profit-Share Incentive (Revenue Share upon conference profitability)
  
  
​Executive Secretariat (Department Heads)
  
​1. Under-Secretary-General (USG) of Delegate Relations & Recruitment
  
  
​Overview: Leads strategy for attracting delegates, managing school delegations, overseeing the registration pipeline, and serving as the primary liaison for participant inquiries.
  
​Key Tasks: Outreach strategy, delegate onboarding, delegation outreach, and managing delegate support channels.
  
  
​2. Under-Secretary-General (USG) of Media, Design & Communications
  
  
​Overview: Directs the brand identity, marketing campaigns, and public relations for the offline conference.
  
​Key Tasks: Managing the creative team, approving social media/print materials, and directing event media coverage.
  
  
​3. Under-Secretary-General (USG) of Technology & Logistics
  
  
​Overview: Oversees physical event logistics, venue setup, equipment, on-site tech infrastructure, and digital tools.
  
​Key Tasks: Venue operations management, IT/AV deployment, schedule execution, and managing the logistics & developer staff.
  
  
​Academic & Committee Staff
  
  
​4. Academic Researcher
  
  
​Overview: Drafts high-quality background guides, topic synopses, and study materials for delegates ahead of the conference.
  
​Key Tasks: Subject matter research, drafting committee guides, setting debate parameters, and verifying delegate position papers.
  
  
​5. Committee Moderator
  
​Overview: Assists committee chairs on-site during debate sessions to ensure smooth flow, track speakers, and manage parliamentary procedure.
  
​Key Tasks: Managing speaker lists, timing speeches, tallying votes, and assisting with draft resolutions.
  
  
​Delegate Affairs & Equity
  
  
​6. Delegate Affairs Officer
  
  
​Overview: Serves as the primary point of contact for individual delegates and faculty advisors before and during the event.
  
​Key Tasks: On-site registration/check-in, badge distribution, help-desk operations, and resolving delegate queries during committee hours.
  
  
​7. Equity & Accessibility Officer
  
  
​Overview: Ensures an inclusive, safe, and respectful environment for all participants throughout the conference.
  
​Key Tasks: Enforcing code of conduct guidelines, addressing accessibility/special accommodations needs, and mediating any delegate disputes or policy violations on-site
  
  
​Media, Marketing & Design Team
  
  
​8. Social Media Manager & Content Creator
  
  
​Overview: Drives engagement across digital channels leading up to and during the live offline event.
  
​Key Tasks: Planning content calendars, creating short-form video content/reels, live-posting during conference days, and managing audience interaction.
  
  
​9. Graphic Designer
  
  
​Overview: Creates all visual assets for both online promotion and physical conference materials.
  
​Key Tasks: Designing social media assets, print materials (placards, banners, delegate handbooks, certificates, badges), and event branding elements.
  
  
​10. Copywriter & Communications Associate
  
  
​Overview: Crafts compelling written content for outreach, press releases, delegate emails, and promotional materials.
  
​Key Tasks: Writing promotional emails, website copy, delegate guides, and official conference announcements.
  
  
​11. Outreach & Partnership Associate
  
  
​Overview: Builds relationships with schools, universities, MUN clubs, and partner organizations to secure group delegations.
  
​Key Tasks: Direct communication with educational institutions, partner negotiations, and tracking prospective delegation pipelines.
  
  
​Technology & Logistics Team
  
  
​12. Full-Stack / Web Developer
  
  
​Overview: Builds and maintains the conference website, custom registration portals, and digital event platforms.
  
​Key Tasks: Developing web forms, maintaining real-time schedules/announcements on the site, and integrating delegate registration systems.
  
  
​13. Logistics & On-Site Event Coordinator
  
  
​Overview: Manages physical setup, vendor coordination, room allocations, and live event movement.
  
​Key Tasks: Room setup and venue prep, managing printed conference kits, directing delegate flow between sessions, and resolving on-site operational issues.
  
​Compensation Note for Postings
  
  
​Compensation Structure: All roles are offered as 6-month volunteer/internship positions with professional certificates and references. Since this is a fee-based offline conference, team members are eligible for a profit-share model calculated and distributed following successful post-event financial reconciliation.

By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Senior Business Systems Analyst - Results Delivery Office (RDO)**
**Location:**
**On-site**
– Hyderabad India (minimum of 3
**nights**
a week in for cross over time with PST leadership)
  
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Business Systems Analystrole offers an exciting opportunity to join a small, high-performing technology team supporting the Results Delivery Office (RDO).
  
  
This role will serve as a technical analyst supporting the technology roadmap for RDO, including new and existing AI products, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint-based products, Power Automate solutions, and related digital capabilities. The ideal candidate is a customer-focused, hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into clear requirements, help shape solution direction, support build and configuration activities, and provide white-glove service to stakeholders who expect a high-touch partnership model. This role will be responsible for both helping build and launch new products and enhancements, as well as maintaining, supporting, and continuously improving existing AI, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and automation products after go-live.
  
  
This is a versatile, hands-on role suited for someone who can wear many hats across business analysis, product support, roadmap planning, low-code/no-code automation, AI solution enablement, documentation, testing, release support, and operational maintenance. The role is especially well suited for a technically minded analyst or engineer who enjoys client-facing work, thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to help a small team deliver high-value technology outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Partner with RDO leaders, business stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and vendors to understand business objectives and translate them into actionable technology roadmap items, features, user stories, and requirements.
* Support new and existing AI products, including intake, use case discovery, requirements definition, process mapping, testing, adoption support, and ongoing maintenance activities.
* Support SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Power Automate-based products and workflows, including enhancements, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Capture the voice of the customer and deliver white-glove support through proactive communication, strong follow-through, and clear expectation management.
* Elicit, document, and refine business, functional, non-functional, data, reporting, security, privacy, and operational requirements.
* Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, use cases, test scenarios, and lightweight solution documentation.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize product backlogs, release scopes, maintenance needs, defects, and enhancement requests.
* Help define and maintain technology roadmaps, delivery plans, release notes, adoption materials, product documentation, support guides, and stakeholder communications.
* Assist with solution design, configuration, testing, validation, and deployment for AI-enabled tools, SharePoint solutions, Power Automate flows, dashboards, and related digital capabilities.
* Support proofs of concept, pilots, and experiments for AI, automation, and collaboration solutions, including success criteria, risk considerations, stakeholder feedback, and transition-to-production planning.
* Use internal AI capabilities and approved tools to improve productivity, summarize information, support analysis, develop drafts, and identify opportunities for process automation.
* Support responsible AI practices by helping document business purpose, expected outcomes, risks, controls, human review points, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled solutions.
* Perform initial triage, troubleshooting, and support coordination for product issues, data questions, access requests, workflow failures, and user feedback.
* Coordinate small enhancements and maintenance activities across a lean team of approximately three resources, flexing between build, run, analysis, testing, documentation, and stakeholder support as needed.
* Prepare and deliver product demonstrations, training materials, walkthroughs, and stakeholder updates for business and technology audiences.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, increase adoption, and improve user experience.
* Operate effectively in Agile delivery models while adapting to other frameworks and ways of working as needed for the business group.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field AND
* 4+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, technology analysis, product analysis, digital solutions, information systems, engineering, or a related technology delivery role.
* Experience supporting business stakeholders in a client-facing or product-support capacity.
* Experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, or another regulated industry is an added advantage.

**Functional Skills**
**Must-Have Skills**

* Business analysis experience, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, user story creation, acceptance criteria, testing support, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Strong customer focus with proven ability to provide high-touch, white-glove support to business partners and senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Agile ways of working, including Scrum, Kanban, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts, generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI assistants/copilots, responsible AI, and common enterprise AI use cases.
* Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration platforms, including SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Lists, Forms, and permissions concepts.
* Experience with Power Platform capabilities, especially Power Automate; exposure to Power Apps and Power BI is preferred.
* Ability to partner with technical teams to support solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with ability to investigate issues, synthesize information, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate technical or complex concepts into business-friendly language.
* Ability to work independently in a small team, manage multiple priorities, and flex across build, run, support, documentation, and stakeholder engagement responsibilities.

title: Client Solution Analyst – Engineering & BI
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Shift:**
Evening Shift / US Shift
  
  
**Experience:**
Minimum 3 Years
  
  
**Function:**
Engineering / Business Intelligence (BI) / Client Solutions
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Client Solution Analyst – Engineering & BI**
to work at the intersection of
**clients, Business Operations, and Engineering teams**
.
  
  
This role will focus on understanding business and client requirements, translating them into clear and actionable requirements for Engineering and BI teams, coordinating solution delivery, analyzing business data, and ensuring effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate does not need to be a developer but should have a
**good understanding of technology and engineering environments**
, with the ability to understand technical concepts, communicate business requirements effectively, and collaborate closely with Engineering and BI teams.
  
  
**Key ResponsibilitiesClient & Business Requirement Management**

* Work closely with clients and Business Operations teams to understand business needs, challenges, workflows, and enhancement requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into clear, structured requirements that Engineering and BI teams can understand and execute.
* Conduct requirement discussions to clarify business logic, expected outcomes, priorities, and dependencies.
* Act as a key point of coordination for client and business requirements through the solution lifecycle.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide updates on requirements and solution progress.

***Engineering & BI Coordination***

* Act as a bridge between clients, Business Operations, Engineering, and BI teams.
* Work closely with engineers and BI teams to communicate business requirements and clarify functional expectations.
* Facilitate discussions between technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment.
* Coordinate solution requirements, priorities, dependencies, and changes with relevant teams.
* Track requirements and ensure appropriate follow-up through implementation.
* Help Business Operations understand technical considerations, limitations, and solution approaches communicated by Engineering teams.

***Business Intelligence & Data Analysis***

* Work with BI and Business Operations teams to understand reporting and data requirements.
* Analyze business and client data to identify trends, gaps, exceptions, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support requirements for reports, dashboards, metrics, and other BI solutions.
* Understand business metrics and help ensure reporting requirements accurately reflect operational needs.
* Translate business questions into structured data and reporting requirements.
* Provide insights that support operational and client-related decision-making.

***Solution & Implementation Coordination***

* Understand client and operational challenges and work with Engineering and BI teams to identify appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate requirements from initial discussion through development and implementation.
* Monitor progress and facilitate communication between stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Support the rollout and adoption of new solutions, enhancements, reports, and process changes.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with the original business objectives and client requirements.

***Requirement Documentation***

* Prepare and maintain clear documentation of business requirements, functional requirements, workflows, specifications, and change requests.
* Draft and finalize specifications with approval from the relevant User Department HOD or Business Owner before development begins.
* Maintain documentation of client requirements, approvals, decisions, changes, and implementation updates.
* Ensure requirements are clearly communicated and traceable across Business Operations, Engineering, and BI teams.

***Process Improvement & Automation***

* Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows and client-facing processes.
* Work with Business Operations and Engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.
* Analyze recurring business or client challenges and support the development of scalable solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across business processes, reporting, and service delivery.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in Client Solutions, Business Analysis, Business Operations, BI, Product Operations, Engineering Operations, or a related role.
* Strong requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation skills.
* Experience working with Engineering/Technology teams and Business Operations stakeholders.
* Good understanding of technology and the ability to understand technical discussions without necessarily having hands-on development experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of business data, reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into requirements that technical teams can understand and technical information into language that business stakeholders can understand.
* Strong coordination, organization, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and manage competing priorities.

**Preferred Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* An Engineering or technology-related educational/professional background would be preferred.
* Exposure to Business Intelligence, analytics, dashboards, or reporting tools would be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of databases, data flows, system integrations, or software applications is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Experience working in an Engineering, Product, SaaS, technology, or data-driven business environment is preferred.
* Experience working with global or US-based clients/stakeholders would be an advantage.

title: GB/G Purchase-to-Pay Procurement Trainer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
  
  
We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities.
  
  
**BASF Overview**
BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Purchase-to-Pay Procurement Trainer / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support knowledge transition and capability development within our Purchase-to-Pay Procurement team. The incumbent will receive process handovers from the sending location, capture and validate process knowledge, and deliver structured classroom, virtual, and on-the-job training to new Hub colleagues at the receiving location. The role requires strong knowledge of direct and indirect procurement finance, operational purchasing, supplier-facing activities, purchasing controls, and SAP procurement processes, hands-on SAP experience, and excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  
  
The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between the sending and receiving locations, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer, robust process documentation, learner readiness, process standardization, and sustainable capability development within the receiving entity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative
* Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways
* Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture
* Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote)

**Key Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Transfer & Transition Management**

* Act as an individual contributor and the primary point of contact for process transition from colleagues at the sending location.
* Participate in transition sessions, process walkthroughs, knowledge-transfer activities, and process validation discussions.
* Develop detailed knowledge of direct and indirect procurement activities, including requisition handling, source determination, request-for-quotation support, purchase-order processing, order changes, goods and service receipt coordination, and reporting.
* Capture category and country variations, approval workflows, purchasing controls, supplier dependencies, service-level expectations, exceptions, risks, and escalation paths in process documentation and training materials.
* Conduct reverse knowledge-transfer sessions, learner assessments, readiness checks, and post-transition support to confirm that receiving-location colleagues can execute procurement activities independently.
* Ensure a smooth and controlled handover of responsibilities to the receiving team.

**Training & Capability Development**

* Design, develop, and deliver functional training programs covering direct and indirect procurement, operational purchasing, supplier-facing activities, purchasing controls, and SAP procurement processes.
* Translate business-process and SAP concepts into clear, practical learning content for varied audiences.
* Conduct classroom, virtual, and on-the-job training for new and existing team members.
* Prepare and maintain training materials, desktop procedures, user guides, process maps, simulations, and job aids.
* Assess learner understanding through evaluations, practical exercises, feedback sessions, and knowledge checks.
* Identify knowledge gaps and provide coaching and post-training support to strengthen team capability.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with sending-location colleagues, process owners, business partners, and cross-functional teams to achieve transition and training objectives.
* Communicate complex process concepts clearly and professionally to diverse audiences.
* Build effective working relationships across cultures and time zones, with flexibility to coordinate during the transition period.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline; a relevant procurement qualification is an advantage.
* Minimum 8-10 years of relevant industry experience in direct or indirect procurement, operational purchasing, procure-to-pay, purchasing operations, or a shared-services environment.
* Demonstrated subject matter expertise in direct and indirect procurement processes, including purchase requisitions, source determination, request for quotation, supplier selection support, purchase-order creation and changes, outline agreements, goods and service receipt coordination, blocked-order resolution, supplier communication, purchasing controls, and reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience working in an MNC, captive center, or Global Capability Center (GCC) is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with SAP ERP (ECC and/or S/4HANA), including Materials Management and procurement processes such as purchase requisitions, purchase orders, source lists, outline agreements, goods receipts, service entries, and reporting, with the ability to explain transactions and system activities to end users.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant reporting or workflow tools.

**About BASF**
At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.
  
  
At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

title: Staff Project Analyst
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Operations Group, Operations Group > Project Analyst
  
  
**General Summary**
The CHS (Central Hardware System) Operations team is looking for a Staff Project Analyst, based in India, with a drive to self-succeed and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This person will lead operations and resource planning across the chipset programs we engage on out of the region, providing program and operations support to hardware engineering and design teams while working closely with global cross-geo teams across US time zones. They will lead the development and management of processes, procedures, and tools that increase productivity and improve existing flows, and recommend alternate system management tools to satisfy core business objectives
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of relevant work experience.

OR
  
  
Associate's degree and 4+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
High School Diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead operations, resource, and capacity planning across the region's chipset programs — spanning CAD, Mechanical, and PCB design activities — in partnership with hardware platform program managers.
* Own and continuously enhance CHS Operations systems, SharePoint lists, and Power Automate flows that support program execution; drive enhancement requests from intake through release.
* Own end-to-end hardware R&D program management — project-manage from design through tape-out, fab, builds, bring-up, testing, and release.
* Own external design-services partner bookkeeping and planning (Mechanical, PCB layout, and PCB library): work with Contracts and Finance on purchase orders, accounting, and capacity loading, and automate these functions where possible.
* Lead financial roll-ups across products and quarters by partnering with cross-functional teams; deliver clear, audit-ready summaries for executive review and official submission.
* Drive the fiscal year budget intake and consolidation process; build and operate budget dashboards that give leadership a real-time view of plan vs. actuals and forecast risk.
* Design, build, and maintain executive dashboards using Power BI (and Tableau where applicable) that turn operational data into decisions; define KPIs, data models, and refresh cadence.
* Provide operations leadership and consultation to functional teams across the program; serve as the connective tissue between program management, engineering, finance, and supplier-facing teams.
* Lead resource planning, capacity modeling, and gap analysis across active and pipeline projects; surface staffing and bandwidth risks early.
* Drive product reviews across core program meetings — own agendas, capture decisions and action items, and hold owners accountable to closure with documented evidence.
* Own end-to-end management of program milestones, change requests, and risks.
* Coordinate material ordering for Mechanical teardowns and prototype builds, and support substrate prototype ordering.
* Establish and roll out new program management processes, methods, and tools (tracking systems, schedules, databases, documentation management) — and retire those that no longer deliver value.
* Lead project planning activities including integrated schedules, work breakdown structures, dependency maps, and critical-path analysis.
* Architect Power Automate workflows on top of new and existing SharePoint lists to eliminate manual operational toil and improve data quality.
* Mentor junior project analysts and program coordinators; codify reusable templates, playbooks, and operating standards.
* Represent CHS Operations to senior leadership (Director / VP audience) — produce executive briefings, gate review packages, and quarterly business reviews.

title: Artwork Strategist - Global Artwork
description:
**Why this role matters**
Every artwork change sits at the intersection of multiple requirements – Regulatory, technical elements, Supply Chain, packaging and business.
  
  
As an Artwork Strategist, you help ensure those requirements come together correctly before artwork is executed.
  
  
Your judgement and ability to identify issues early will directly contribute to compliant, timely and right-first-time artwork delivery, supporting Amgen products and patients around the world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As an Artwork Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in translating Amgen's labelling and implementation strategies into artwork projects that are ready for successful implementation by the artwork executional team.
  
  
Sitting at the intersection of Regulatory, Supply Chain, Packaging and Artwork, you will ensure that the strategy for implementing product launches and labelling variations is sound and that the information provided to our Artwork Designers and Reviewers is accurate, complete and ready for execution.
  
  
This is not simply an artwork coordination role. You will be expected to connect the dots, ask the right questions, challenge where something does not look right and proactively drive issues to resolution.
  
  
You will support products and markets globally and work with a broad network of colleagues across Amgen.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
You will:
  
  

* Participate in artwork implementation strategies for product launches, labelling variations and lifecycle changes, ensuring regulatory and Supply Chain implementation requirements are correctly translated into artwork execution.
* Assess artwork readiness, ensuring Designers and Reviewers receive accurate, complete and consistent inputs before artwork activities begin.
* Bring together and reconcile inputs from multiple functions, including Regulatory Operations, Supply Chain Project Management, Packaging Engineering, Master Data Management, Serialization and HFE-ID.
* Identify missing, conflicting or unclear requirements and proactively work with stakeholders to resolve them before they impact artwork execution.
* Manage and prioritize multiple artwork projects, ensuring activities progress in time to achieve required artwork start dates and business milestones.
* Support artwork projects through the applicable stages, including test artworks, mock-ups and master artworks, ensuring the agreed implementation strategy is maintained throughout execution.
* Apply your understanding of packaging sites, packaging lines, regulatory requirements and Supply Chain processes when assessing artwork implementation approaches.
* Support product launches and labelling variations across global regions, whilst maintaining sufficient cross-regional knowledge to provide effective back-up when required.
* Represent Global Artwork in cross-functional projects and contribute to improvements in artwork processes, systems and automation.

**What We Are Looking For**
You will thrive in this role if you enjoy working in a complex environment where there is not always a straightforward answer.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can absorb information from several sources, understand how the pieces fit together and recognize when something is missing or inconsistent. You are comfortable speaking up, constructively challenging assumptions and influencing stakeholders to reach the right outcome.
  
  
**You Will Bring**

* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Supply Chain, Life Sciences, Engineering, Packaging, Pharmaceutical Operations or a related field.
* Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational and priority-setting capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple activities and changing business needs.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Confidence working independently and taking ownership for progressing issues to resolution.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across functions, cultures and geographies.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Experience**
9+ years of experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
  
  

* Pharmaceutical, biotechnology or another regulated industry.
* Pharmaceutical labelling variations and lifecycle management.
* Pharmaceutical packaging, packaging operations or packaging lines.
* Regulatory, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering or Manufacturing.
* Artwork or labelling operations.

title: Senior Associate, Federal Grants
description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Global Award-Winning Culture
* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth

The Senior Associate, Federal Grants will work directly with Ryan team members and Ryan clients/companies to support the development of government funding applications and proposals by playing a key role in researching requirements and writing and editing application and proposal content as a member of a grant writing team. They may also support Ryan in post-award compliance activities and provide other grant-related support requested by clients. In addition, the Senior Associate will lead research on U.S. government grants, loans, and contracts and related legislation to ensure the firm's grants knowledge is continually updated. The position will demand high attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in constantly changing environments. The position requires strong writing, critical thinking, decision-making, and analysis skills as well as an ability to comprehend and synthesize complex concepts and communicate clearly with stakeholders. The position requires the ability to effectively use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance workflow efficiency while exercising independent judgment and critical thinking when evaluating information and making decisions.
  
  
The position involves significant project management skills to research and support the development and writing of grant and loan applications and contract proposals that are anticipated to range from $100,000 to $100,000,000+ in size. These funding applications are positioned to assist our clients’ businesses with their unique projects and could cover a wide array of industries included, but not limited to: energy, agriculture, health, manufacturing, industry, education, and research and development.
  
  
**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**

* Overall Team Support: Our team works together to support multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. The Senior Associate will be communicating, collaborating, and working directly with Ryan Managers and Consultants and third party stakeholders.
* Project Management: This role involves leading and writing multiple, concurrent projects and managing them effectively to ensure the final products meet internal and client standards.
* Administrative Duties: Recordkeeping and reporting to senior management, including use of Ryan’s internal file and client management systems.
* Internal Meetings: Meeting preparation and facilitation for internal weekly Grant team meetings. (The primary Grants team members are currently located in Washington, DC on Eastern Time so the Senior Associate shall assume that the weekly meetings, and any client support meetings, will occur in line with Eastern Time zone.)
* Other: The Senior Associate will be called on to support special projects, high-priority items, new/existing funding program research, review of existing materials, and updates and enhancements to team products and marketing materials, etc.

**Client**

* Funding Strategizing and Project Scoping: The Senior Associate will be responsible for researching specific funding opportunities for Ryan clients and as such will need to develop a strong understanding of our clients’ projects and areas of investment. The Senior Associate will gather/synthesize project information, identify possible grants and funding opportunities of potential relevance, and prepare reports and materials to summarize the scoped opportunities for review by Ryan staff and ultimate presentation and sharing with clients.
* Information Gathering and Analysis: Support client engagements, company and project information gathering, project scoping and strategizing, and communicating program and project details to Ryan staff and clients, if/as requested.
* Client Relationship Management: The Senior Associate may be invited to client meetings and as such will be required to manage client requests and expectations effectively. They will develop strong working relationships with Ryan staff and clients to ensure project completion and successful submission of requested deliverables.

**Value**

* Conduct Ongoing Grants Research (30%): Support with ongoing grant program research to ensure the Firm’s knowledge is up to date. This involves researching through a variety of online sources, including current U.S. Federal appropriation and legislative materials, reviewing client data and publicly available reports and information on grant and funding vehicles.
* Support Application and Proposal Research, Preparation, Writing, and Reviewing (30%): Either on their own or with a Ryan team member, work on the preparation and submission of funding applications and proposals for clients. This includes synthesizing project information gathered from research, client meetings, notes from the sales team or Manager, and previous funding proposals. They will evaluate and interpret quantitative and qualitative information from credible sources; identify supporting evidence and trends, and incorporate properly cited data into applications. The Senior Consultant will be asked to develop narrative content, budget materials, and graphically rich appendices and executive summary materials. An Engagement Manager, Director, or Senior Consultant will review work and provide feedback for changes or improvement before submitting.
* Support Systemization and Document Management (20%): As documentation for a project comes in, the Senior Associate will be responsible for filing and storing the documents appropriately on our system and ensuring they can be located for later use. The Senior Associate is responsible for maintaining the integrity and consistency of our file management system. The Senior Associate may be asked to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data-driven recommendations.
* Provide Sales and Marketing Support (20%): The Senior Associate will support, and sometimes lead, the development of marketing materials and sales tools and other thought leadership documentation to assist in the marketing and sales process for the U.S. federal grants sub-practice.

**Education And Experience**
A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business/Administration, English or Communications/Journalism, or a related discipline is required. Prior experience in Grants, familiarity with U.S. government programs, and broad business experience and business plan writing would be strong assets.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* 2-3 years of experience in industry with progressive responsibility
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM
* Excellent writing skills and experience presenting written submissions C level executives
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* High comfort level working independently and in a team environment
* Strong decision-making skills: ability to work with limited information
* Strong research skills
* Ability to work confidently under pressure with tight timelines
* Experience working in a client facing role
* English fluency, both oral and written

**Qualifications Preferred**

* Experience writing grant or contract proposal narratives
* Expertise leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research and content development
* Experience reporting to, or working with, clients and business leaders
* Strong ability to manage client expectations
* Industry experience in roles that include strategic planning, project management, or similar
* Demonstrated editorial, graphic design, or marketing skills

**Computer Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft® Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Internet navigation and research. Experience with generative AI tools is also preferred.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Title:

The main purpose of the Safety Reporting Business Application Specialist position is:
  
  
To provide operational pharmacovigilance expertise and business systems support for global safety reporting activities and systems. The role will combine a strong understanding of day-to-day safety reporting requirements with the systems knowledge needed to support Global Safety Reporting leadership and activities across the safety reporting software development lifecycle. * Translating safety reporting business needs and regulatory requirements into business and functional solutions.
* Supporting compliant and timely distribution of SUSARs, SUSAR Line Listings, and Development Safety Update Reports.

Major responsibilities are listed in order of approximate percentage of time. The percentages may vary according to project and operational priorities.

**Safety Reporting Operations & Business Analysis - 55%**

* Provide subject matter expertise for global safety reporting activities, including SUSARs, SUSAR Line Listings, and Development Safety Update Reports, and ensure system solutions support timely and accurate distribution to investigators, Independent Ethics Committees, and Institutional Review Boards in line with applicable requirements.

* Analyze system architecture, interfaces, data flows, business rules, and dependencies to assess operational impact and support business decisions. Work with technical teams to investigate incidents, identify root causes, assess business impact, and define sustainable corrective solutions.
* Review proposed system designs, interfaces, and configurations from a business and compliance perspective.
* Support data queries, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and technical analysis using appropriate database and reporting tools.
* Contribute to the design, configuration, testing, validation, release readiness, deployment, and post-deployment support of safety reporting system changes.

Maintain clear business and functional documentation to support system reliability, knowledge transfer within Global Safety Reporting, audit readiness, and business continuity.
  
  
10%

title: Training Associate

title: AI SOLUTION ENGINEER
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Job title**

Associate AI Solution Engineer

1. JOB Purpose

To design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent chatbots, and AI agent frameworks. The role will focus on building secure, scalable, and business-ready AI applications for internal users and business functions including Research & Development, IT, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance and corporate functions.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge in
**Generative AI**
and should bring experience working in implementing intelligent systems that enable computers to understand, analyze, and reason with both
**visual and textual data**
in a manner similar to human cognition along with basic understanding of pharmaceutical and biotechnology processes, regulatory documentation, SOPs, controlled documents, and compliance-driven environments. The Candidate should have basic knowledge of Software Development.

This position is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

1. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

**AI Chatbot, RAG & Agent Development**

* Develop research and product roadmaps aligning with scientific and business objectives.
* Develop AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants for internal business users.
* Build RAG-based applications that retrieve answers from SharePoint, PDFs, Word documents, SOPs, policies, databases, and internal knowledge repositories.
* Create AI agent workflows for knowledge retrieval, document review, authoring, and business process automation.
* Use frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Llama Index, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools under technical guidance.
* Apply prompt engineering, grounding techniques, response validation, and evaluation methods to improve answer quality and reduce hallucinations.

**Data & Knowledge Integration**

* Support document ingestion pipelines for PDFs, Word files, Excel files, SOPs, regulatory content, and knowledge articles.
* Work on chunking, metadata extraction, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, and citation-based response generation.
* Use vector databases/search tools such as Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB

**Application Development & Deployment**

* Develop backend APIs and AI services using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Develop document processing solutions using OCR, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and intelligent data extraction technique
* Support deployment and maintenance of AI applications using Azure services, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Security, Governance & Documentation**

* Follow organizational security, privacy, access control, and data governance standards while developing AI solutions.
* Support responsible AI practices including auditability, monitoring, explainability, and controlled use of enterprise data.
* Prepare technical documentation, user guides, architecture notes, test cases, and validation-support documents where required.

3. QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's or master's degrees in engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Machine Learning, or a related engineering discipline.
* 2-5 years of experience in AI engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or application development.

description:

 **Policy and Procedures Manager**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage the delivery of agreed policy/procedure updates for the Advised (Financial Planning/Wealth Advice) Journey, from initiation through approval and publication.

* Deliver end\-to\-end change delivery using project management disciplines: plan milestones, manage dependencies, track actions/risks/issues, and escalate early when needed.
* Partner with key stakeholders (Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, Controls, Technology, Wealth propositions and distribution) to gather requirements, resolve conflicts, and secure timely approvals.
* Create clear changes in communications (what changed, why, who’s impacted, effective date, required actions) and support training coordination where required.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Knowledge of Wealth Management and Regulated Financial Planning/Advice journeys, including Wealth Manager working practices and customer outcomes considerations.
* Demonstrable experience working within structured deliveries (work plans, governance, Risk Audit Issues Dependencies, dependencies, timelines) across multiple stakeholders.
* Comfortable working within Agile delivery environments and supporting backlog prioritization and sequencing. Proven ability to take accountability, work independently, and drive work to completion with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* Excellent written communication skills able to turn complex requirements into clear, consistent, audit\-ready documentation.
* 8\+ years of experience with a masters/bachelor’s degree.
* Review and input into key governance documents ensuring risks and issues are mitigated or formally accepted. Confident stakeholder management across functions and seniority; able to facilitate working sessions and close actions.
* JIRA, Confluence (or equivalent), and strong command of Microsoft Office (Word/PowerPoint/Excel). Advised Journey policies/procedures are current, consistent, and usable approvals and evidence are complete and traceable.

 **SharePoint Associate Architect** 
 to take ownership of our enterprise SharePoint landscape, shaping strategy, governance, and technical delivery across the Group.  Working with senior stakeholders, IT teams, architects, and third\-party partners, you'll combine strong technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver secure, scalable, and user\-focused solutions that enable business success.

* You'll design and deliver custom SharePoint solutions using Microsoft 365, Power Platform, automation, integrations, and low\-code/no\-code technologies to meet business needs.
* You'll provide technical leadership by collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, support teams, and third\-party vendors to resolve complex issues and deliver successful project outcomes.

* You possess broad technical expertise across the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, SQL Server, Azure services, system integrations, and low\-code/no\-code platforms.
* You demonstrate excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate, influence, and deliver results effectively in complex global environments, independently or as part of a team.

Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

title: Training Specialist II, Account Health Support
description:
**Description**
 Do you want to define and drive the learning strategy for an organization that impacts thousands of associates globally?
   

  

 As a Site Trainer, you will own the end\-to\-end training lifecycle — from identifying strategic learning needs to designing scalable programs, mentoring trainers, and measuring business\-level impact. You will bring deep expertise in communication training and instructional design to shape how teams develop, perform, and grow. This role goes beyond delivery — you will set the direction, influence stakeholders, and build training frameworks that scale across sites and geographies.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Training Strategy \& Program Ownership
   

  

* Own and drive the training strategy for assigned programs or business lines, defining learning roadmaps aligned with organizational goals and operational priorities
* Design and implement scalable training frameworks that can be replicated across sites, teams, and geographies
* Identify emerging skill gaps through proactive analysis of business trends, performance data, and stakeholder input; develop strategic interventions without waiting for escalation
* Lead the design and rollout of organization\-wide communication excellence programs (business writing, verbal fluency, presentation skills, stakeholder communication)


 Advanced Training Delivery \& Communication Coaching
   

  

* Facilitate high\-complexity training sessions including leadership communication workshops, advanced soft skills programs, and cross\-functional capability\-building initiatives
* Serve as the subject matter expert for communication training — design and deliver modules on accent modification, business communication, customer interaction strategies, and executive communication
* Lead Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) programs to build trainer capability across sites; certify and calibrate trainers on delivery standards
* Design and facilitate simulations, role\-plays, and scenario\-based learning for complex, ambiguous situations


 Curriculum Design \& Innovation
   

  

* Architect comprehensive curricula using advanced instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning Design) with emphasis on scalability and learner experience
* Pioneer innovative learning formats (microlearning, gamification, AI\-assisted content, peer learning communities) to drive engagement and retention
* Establish content governance standards — version control, review cadence, and retirement criteria for training materials
* Design multi\-level assessment frameworks including competency\-based evaluations, capstone projects, and certification pathways


 Data\-Driven Training Effectiveness \& Impact
   

  

* Define and own training effectiveness metrics across the full Kirkpatrick model (Levels 1\-4\); establish causal links between training programs and business outcomes
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that communicate training ROI, learner progression, and capability development trends
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on underperforming programs; develop and execute improvement action plans with measurable targets
* Benchmark training programs against industry standards and internal best practices; drive continuous improvement through data


 Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Quality, WFM, and HR to align training investments with business strategy
* Represent training in business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs) — present insights, advocate for learning initiatives, and influence resource allocation decisions
* Mentor and develop Training Specialists; provide structured coaching, feedback, and career development guidance
* Drive cross\-site standardization of training practices while adapting for local context and needs


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning may begin with a strategy session with operations leadership, aligning training priorities with upcoming business goals and identifying capability gaps across multiple programs. You then review training effectiveness data across sites, spotting trends and crafting recommendations for program redesign. Mid\-day, you mentor a team of trainers on advanced facilitation techniques and provide feedback on their curriculum designs. In the afternoon, you lead a cross\-functional working group to launch a new communication excellence program, defining the rollout plan, success metrics, and stakeholder communication strategy. You close the day by presenting quarterly training impact analysis to senior leadership, demonstrating how your programs drove measurable improvements in quality scores and operational KPIs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Training team is dedicated to accelerating specialist readiness and continuous development at scale. We partner closely with Operations, Quality, and Workforce Management across multiple sites and geographies to deliver learning solutions that drive performance outcomes. Our vision is to build a culture of continuous learning where every specialist has the skills and confidence to deliver world\-class service. As a Site Trainer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping team strategy, mentoring junior trainers, and raising the bar for learning programs across the organization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of learning design, learning science, instructional design, educational psychology, or similar field experience
* Experience with Learning \& Development and course facilitation or an equivalent professional qualification, or experience in a training role, including technical training, or a mix of training, performance management and coaching/mentoring
* Experience designing and delivering training programs at scale across multiple teams or sites
* Experience mentoring or leading other trainers (formally or informally)
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) strategy, governance, and reporting


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Organizational Development, Communication, Instructional Design, or a related field
* Experience as a Communication or Soft Skills Trainer with program\-level ownership in a contact center, BPO, or customer service environment
* Professional certification in Learning \& Development (e.g., CPTM, ATD\-CPTD, CIPD, or equivalent)
* Experience with e\-learning authoring tools (Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, or similar) at an advanced level
* Experience in designing and delivering accent modification or language proficiency coaching programs
* Process improvement certification (Six Sigma Green Belt, Lean, or Kaizen)

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

 OUR MISSION
   

  

 At Redwood Software, we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights\-out automation for their mission\-critical business processes.
   

  

**About Us**
 Redwood Software is the leader in full\-stack automation for mission\-critical business processes. With the first SaaS\-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in automation's transformative power. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage, and monitor their workflows across any application, service, or server — in the cloud or on\-premise — with confidence and control.
   

  

 CORE VALUES
   

  

 One Team. One Redwood Make Your Own Weather Obsess over Customer Success Work the Problem Be Curious Own the Outcome Respect Each Other
   

  

 YOUR IMPACT
   

  

 As a Technical Writer at Redwood, you'll create and maintain documentation for our Tidal product line, working closely with product, engineering, and UX/design to keep customer\-facing documentation and in\-product content accurate and consistent.
   

  

 You bring solid technical writing skills and sound judgment on ambiguous product or design questions. You're curious about applying AI tools to your own workflow, and comfortable partnering with designers and senior writers on content strategy. You'll follow and contribute to documentation and content design standards set by the team, and make structural or strategic content calls as they arise, looping in your lead on cross\-team tradeoffs.
   

  

 Documentation Development
   

  

* Write and maintain user guides, implementation documentation, developer content, and release notes for Tidal and Finance Automation, keeping pace with each release cycle.
* Produce API documentation (e.g., using Swagger/OpenAPI) for developer\-facing endpoints as needed.
* Translate technical concepts — such as job scheduling and workload orchestration in Tidal, or financial close and reconciliation processes in Finance Automation — into content suited to administrators, developers, and business users.
* Keep existing documentation current as products change, verifying accuracy directly with engineering and product owners.


 Content Design Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with UX/design on in\-product content, UI text, tooltips, error messages, onboarding copy.
* Apply established content design principles (structure, findability, consistency) to your own documentation work.
* Identify and resolve content inconsistencies or gaps across docs and in\-product text, looping in the team when a fix touches shared standards.


 AI\-Assisted Documentation
   

  

* Use approved AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, and structuring documentation, always reviewing AI\-assisted output for accuracy before publishing.
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI to documentation workflows, bringing outcomes back to the team.


 Documentation Publishing \& Operations
   

  

* Publish and maintain documentation using the team's Git\-based, docs\-as\-code workflow (Markdown, version control).
* Maintain metadata, organization, and versioning of published docs according to team standards.
* Update published content in response to product changes, customer feedback, and post\-release review.


 Team Collaboration
   

  

* Use Jira and Confluence within established team workflows.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and deliver content aligned to sprint/release cycles.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and scope changes proactively so your lead can adjust priorities and timelines.
* Collaborate with SMEs and product stakeholders to verify technical accuracy.


**Required**
 YOUR EXPERIENCE
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\-5 years of technical writing experience for software products, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience producing user guides, API documentation, and release notes in a fast\-release (Agile/sprint\-based) environment.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration.
* Experience with Git\-based, docs\-as\-code workflows and lightweight markup (e.g., Markdown).
* Experience applying AI tools to documentation work, whether from prior job experience or self\-directed exploration.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, ability to manage multiple priorities.


**Preferred**
* Familiarity with API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Experience partnering with UX/design teams on in\-product content or microcopy.
* Experience with workload automation, enterprise software, or cloud\-based platforms.

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Leads document strategy and authoring of message\-driven, clear and concise regulatory documents in support of submissions and approvals in key markets and other geographies. Provides support for fit\-for\-purpose regulatory documents (clinical pharmacology, clinical, safety) to facilitate speed of information during development, submission, approval, and life cycle management of products in BMS pipeline.
   

  

 Objective: To coordinate and author documents needed for regulatory submissions, ensuring the coordination and integration of the scientific, medical, and regulatory input from cross\-functional team members.
   

  

**Duties/Responsibilities**
* Coordinate and author complex safety aggregate reports, risk management documents and regulatory documents \[eg, Investigator's Brochures (IB), development safety update reports, periodic benefit\-risk evaluation reports, clinical study reports (CSR), and protocols] ensuring the coordination and integration of the scientific, medical, and regulatory input from development team members.
* Participate in relevant document subteam(s) and ensure effective planning and management of timelines for all components of assigned documents.
* Participate in document strategy sessions, including messaging, document flow, logic, and consistency for assigned projects.
* Maintain document prototypes and shells.
* Comply with internal and external processes and guidelines while managing the review process and, on an ongoing basis, resolve issues, errors, or inconsistencies with pertinent team members to ensure timely completion and high quality of assigned documents.


**Reporting Relationship**
 Senior Manager II
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum of BS/BA degree in science (PhD/PharmD/Master’s degree preferred) with approximately 1\-2 years of regulatory documentation or related experience (does not have to be regulatory documentation). All PhD in biological sciences and PharmD candidates are considered.
* Strong writing skills in authoring and managing the production of scientific documents (pharmaceutical regulatory documentation and/or publications in peer\-reviewed journals).
* Ability to analyze and interpret complex data from a broad range of scientific disciplines.
* Basic understanding of global pharmaceutical drug development.
* Ability to manage timelines and quality of work using strong organizational, communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills in a cross\-functional team.
* Expertise in MS Office.
