title: Medical Writer I / Medical Writer II
description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose \- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking Medical Writer I or II, Patient Safety to join our team in a
 **hybrid / on\-site / remote** 
 capacity. As a Medical Writer I or II, Patient Safety, you will support critical pharmacovigilance and safety activities that advance new treatments for patients and ensure regulatory compliance. This position plays a key role in developing regulatory safety documents, managing safety signals, and maintaining the highest standards of scientific accuracy and compliance. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams, follow industry\-standard processes, and contribute to safety operations from product conception through lifecycle management.
   

  

 You'll join a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through developing compelling safety narratives, conducting rigorous signal detection, and ensuring regulatory excellence. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, Medical Writer I or II can explore career paths and expand skills across pharmacovigilance and medical writing.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Prepare, compile, and lead development of scheduled and ad\-hoc aggregate safety reports including Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Periodic Benefit Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRERs), Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), and other regulatory safety documents, ensuring accuracy and timely submission across multiple regions
* Conduct independent signal detection activities by collecting and analyzing safety data from multiple sources including databases, clinical data, literature, and regulatory websites, applying both quantitative and qualitative methodologies to identify potential safety signals
* Prepare comprehensive signal assessment documents such as Drug Safety Reports (DSRs) and Signal Evaluation Reports (SERs), synthesizing data from various sources and providing clear, evidence\-based conclusions
* Conduct systematic literature searches and reviews to summarize safety data, identify emerging safety trends, and support signal evaluation and epidemiology assessments
* Manage signal tracking activities, maintain comprehensive signal logs, identify and resolve data discrepancies in safety data sources, and ensure data integrity across all deliverables
* Assist in preparing and updating Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and related documents, ensuring alignment with safety data and regulatory requirements across therapeutic areas
* Manage client interactions effectively, handle routine queries independently, escalate complex issues appropriately, and deliver proactive status updates while adapting to client\-specific requirements
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, ensure proper archiving of source materials, and support inspection readiness activities to ensure regulatory compliance
* For Medical Writer II positions: Mentor junior team members on technical and soft skills, provide constructive feedback, lead complex client discussions, manage multi\-stakeholder document review cycles, and contribute to process improvement initiatives


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Strengths in analytical thinking, scientific writing, and problem\-solving to interpret complex safety data and draw meaningful conclusions
* Experience working in pharmacovigilance, healthcare, or a regulated environment with understanding of global regulatory requirements
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with both internal stakeholders and external clients
* A patient\-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to producing high\-quality, compliant deliverables
* Comfort working with medical writing tools, MS Office applications, and pharmacovigilance databases and coding dictionaries (MedDRA, WHO\-DD)


**Required Qualifications**
* University degree in Life Sciences, Health, or Biomedical Sciences (such as Pharmacy, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biophysics, Dentistry, or Physiotherapy) or equivalent combination of training and work experience
* 2\+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, medical writing, or related field (Medical Writer I); 4\+ years of experience (Medical Writer II)
* Solid understanding of global pharmacovigilance regulations, medical terminology, and safety\-related concepts
* Proficiency in medical writing tools and MS Office applications with familiarity in pharmacovigilance databases and coding dictionaries
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills with excellent time management and ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience in pharmacovigilance or related safety assessment fields
* Clinical exposure in hospital\-based environments or direct clinical research experience
* Expertise in specific therapeutic areas or product types
* Familiarity with pharmacovigilance systems and regulatory submission processes across multiple regions


 We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
   

  

 If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

 Nextpower is seeking an experienced Sr. Product Applications Engineer\- DFM\&DFA Support to support product application engineering, production drawing verification, product testing, and manufacturing\-readiness activities.

* Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to resolve drawing clarification, manufacturability, component quality, and production\-related concerns.

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **End User Training (EUT) Consultant** 
 is a client\-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
   

  

 The EUT Consultant combines
 **instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills** 
 to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role\-based learning experiences.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role\-based training analysis.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into learning objectives and role\-based learning requirements.
* Support development of training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules.
* Design and develop instructor\-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance\-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices.
* Apply foundational Organizational Change Management principles to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, workshops, knowledge\-transfer, and customer enablement sessions.
* Facilitate interactive and hands\-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders.
* Support train\-the\-trainer, super\-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge\-transfer activities.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self\-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future\-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content\-development, quality, version\-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of learning assessments and evaluation approaches and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in end\-user training, Learning \& Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.
* Experience designing and developing training content for enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience delivering instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices.
* Understanding of the relationship between Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end\-user adoption.
* Ability to understand both business\-process and technology concepts and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self\-directed, and customer\-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.
* Experience in supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands\-on learning, knowledge\-transfer, or train\-the\-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means consistently delivering
 **high\-quality, customer\-focused learning experiences** 
 that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.
   

  

 The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.
   

  

 Success is demonstrated through
 **training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality** 
 , while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.
   

  

**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: GB/G Travel and Expense Management Trainer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
   

  

 We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
   

  

 Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities.
   

  

**BASF Overview**
 BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2\.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Travel and Expense Management Trainer / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support knowledge transition and capability development within our Travel and Expense Management team. The incumbent will receive process handovers from the sending location, capture and validate process knowledge, and deliver structured classroom, virtual, and on\-the\-job training to new Hub colleagues at the receiving location. The role requires strong knowledge of travel and expense management, expense auditing, policy compliance, corporate\-card administration, employee reimbursement, accounting, and controls, hands\-on SAP experience, and excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between the sending and receiving locations, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer, robust process documentation, learner readiness, process standardization, and sustainable capability development within the receiving entity.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative
* Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways
* Access to BASF's world\-class learning \& development programs
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture
* Hybrid work model (mix of on\-site and remote)


**Key Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Transfer \& Transition Management**
* Act as an individual contributor and the primary point of contact for process transition from colleagues at the sending location.
* Participate in transition sessions, process walkthroughs, knowledge\-transfer activities, and process validation discussions.
* Develop detailed knowledge of the end\-to\-end travel and expense process, from travel or expense initiation through submission, audit, approval, posting, reimbursement, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Capture policy and country variations, approval workflows, audit rules, corporate\-card dependencies, documentation requirements, exceptions, risks, and escalation paths in process documentation and training materials.
* Conduct reverse knowledge\-transfer sessions, learner assessments, readiness checks, and post\-transition support to confirm that receiving\-location colleagues can process and support travel and expense activities independently.
* Ensure a smooth and controlled handover of responsibilities to the receiving team.


**Training \& Capability Development**
* Design, develop, and deliver functional training programs covering travel and expense management, expense auditing, policy compliance, corporate\-card administration, employee reimbursement, accounting, and controls.
* Translate business\-process and SAP concepts into clear, practical learning content for varied audiences.
* Conduct classroom, virtual, and on\-the\-job training for new and existing team members.
* Prepare and maintain training materials, desktop procedures, user guides, process maps, simulations, and job aids.
* Assess learner understanding through evaluations, practical exercises, feedback sessions, and knowledge checks.
* Identify knowledge gaps and provide coaching and post\-training support to strengthen team capability.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with sending\-location colleagues, process owners, business partners, and cross\-functional teams to achieve transition and training objectives.
* Communicate complex process concepts clearly and professionally to diverse audiences.
* Build effective working relationships across cultures and time zones, with flexibility to coordinate during the transition period.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Travel Management, or a related discipline
* Minimum 8 \-10 years of relevant industry experience in travel and expense management, employee expense auditing, corporate\-card administration, travel operations, accounts payable, finance operations, or a shared\-services environment.
* Demonstrated subject matter expertise in end\-to\-end travel and expense processes, including employee travel requests, expense\-report submission and audit, policy compliance, receipt and documentation validation, approval workflows, corporate\-card administration, employee reimbursement, accounting and clearing, exception management, reporting, controls, and query resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working in an MNC, captive center, or Global Capability Center (GCC) is preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with SAP ERP (ECC and/or S/4HANA) and relevant travel\-and\-expense solutions, including expense posting, employee reimbursement, corporate\-card transactions, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting, with the ability to explain transactions and system activities to end users.
* Working knowledge of travel requests, expense reports, receipt validation, policy\-based auditing, approval workflows, corporate cards, employee reimbursements, accounting and clearing, reconciliations, exception handling, operational reporting, and internal controls.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant reporting or workflow tools.


**About BASF**
 At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth \- both for the business and for the individuals within it.
   

  

 At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross\-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long\-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world\-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

title: Technical writer
description:
**About Us**
 Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business\-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful's award\-winning AI capabilities accelerate decision\-making, helping Planful users in over 100 countries close faster, accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company with more than 1,500 customers, including Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, Grafton Plc, Gousto, and Specialized, and is backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at Planful.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Technical Content Writer to join our Content team and own content for our AI\-first platform. This is a build\-from\-the\-ground\-up opportunity: redefining how our users interact with AI\-driven planning and analytics, and the content you create will shape how customers understand, trust, and adopt AI\-native workflows — from conversational interfaces to autonomous agents and AI\-generated insights.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You'll work in tight loops with Product Managers to understand what's shipping and why, with UX to make sure in\-product language is clear and consistent, and with Engineers to accurately document how the AI capabilities actually work under the hood. You'll also be expected to work at AI\-native speed: using Claude and other AI tools as a core part of your own workflow to draft, iterate, and scale content quality — while applying your subject\-matter judgment, editorial standards, and domain expertise to everything that ships.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help define what great content looks like for an AI\-first product, not just document features after the fact.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end content for AI\-Platform, including in\-product AI guidance (prompts, suggested actions, agent explanations), onboarding flows, release notes, and help documentation
* Partner closely with PMs to get early visibility into the roadmap and translate new AI capabilities into clear, accurate, user\-facing content
* Collaborate with UX/Product Design on UI text, conversational flows, empty states, and error messaging for AI\-driven interactions, ensuring tone and terminology stay consistent as the product evolves
* Work directly with Engineering to understand model behavior, limitations, and system design well enough to write content that's technically accurate — including how AI outputs are generated, their confidence/limitations, and any human\-in\-the\-loop steps
* Use Claude and other AI writing tools as a primary part of your workflow to draft, restructure, and scale content, while maintaining rigorous human review for accuracy, tone, and domain correctness
* Develop and maintain a scalable content strategy for the AI\-first platform, including reusable content patterns/templates for recurring AI features
* Produce release content for the monthly Agile release cycle (release notes, known issues, release highlights)
* Continuously audit existing content against product changes, flagging where AI behavior updates require content updates
* Help define content guidelines/voice standards for writing about AI features (e.g., how to describe confidence levels, model limitations, and autonomous actions to users)


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3\-6 years of experience researching, writing, and editing content for a software application in an Agile environment
* Demonstrated experience writing content for AI/ML\-powered features or products (conversational UI, generative AI outputs, recommendation/agent systems, etc.)
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude or similar LLM\-based tools) as part of a content production workflow — drafting, editing, summarizing, or repurposing content at scale
* Comfort working directly with Engineering to understand technical/AI system behavior well enough to write about it accurately
* Experience partnering with UX/Product Design on in\-product copy and interaction content
* Experience with wiki\-based, industry\-standard documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, Document360\)
* Finance, EPM, multi\-dimensional modeling, or planning software domain expertise is a strong plus
* Experience creating API documentation is a plus
* Experience with onboarding tools such as Pendo or WalkMe is a plus


 Key Behaviors
   

  

* AI\-fluent – comfortable using AI tools to accelerate content production without sacrificing quality, accuracy, or judgment
* Cross\-functional – builds strong working relationships with PMs, UX, and Engineering, and knows how to pull the right context from each
* Proactive – makes things happen instead of waiting for direction; flags content gaps before they become problems
* Detail\-oriented – manages multiple concurrent workstreams and releases with precision
* Customer\-focused – keeps the end user's understanding and trust in AI features front of mind
* Accountability – owns tasks and outcomes end\-to\-end
* Team player – collaborates and shares learnings with the broader Content team


 Why Planful
   

  

 Planful Exists To Enrich The World By Helping Our Customers And Our People Achieve Peak Performance. To Foster The Best\-in\-class Work We're So Proud Of, We've Created a Best\-in\-class Culture, Including
   

  

* Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and company\-wide Wellness Days
* Supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
* Office hubs in Hyderabad and Indore, with home office setup allowance and monthly Wi\-Fi/cell phone reimbursements
* Employee Resource Groups like Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and more
* People Programs that foster connection and wellbeing, such as Movember, Summer Wellness, Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and Hispanic Heritage Month

description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant, early in their career (with 1 to 2 years of post\-qualification experience), to join one of our cross\-functional product teams in our Gurugram/Hyderabad/Bengaluru office as an Individual Contributor. This product team is responsible for the core portfolio and P\&L accounting product offering on our platform. This role offers the opportunity to build strong domain expertise in fund and portfolio accounting for some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, while working closely with engineers, product managers, and client\-facing teams.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Carry the product/feature from concept to creation
* Brainstorm product/feature and its value proposition to our client base
* Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and product/feature specification via deep dives into domain, gathering requirements and/or business analysis
* Work closely with the engineers/architects to translate the Product Specification to design, and then to the product itself
* Prepare comprehensive business test cases/beds to aid the engineering process
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of product/feature\-in\-flight by leveraging the created test cases/beds and ensure compliance to the product/feature specification and the vision
* Track and question risks/assumptions
* Proactively escalate issues and mitigate execution risks


**What You'll Need**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1\-2 years of post\-qualification experience
* Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial statements, and journal entries
* Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, fund/portfolio accounting concepts such as NAV, P\&L, accruals, and corporate actions.
* Knowledge on fixed income and derivatives will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in Excel; exposure to SQL. Python or LLM agentic tools is an added advantage
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and timeliness
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage multiple lines of work under tight deadlines
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with stakeholders
* A collaborative attitude and willingness to learn from and work closely with cross\-functional Engineering, Product, and Operations teams
* Outstanding academic background and a genuine interest in financial markets and technology

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Analyst – Center for Energy \& Industrials – Research \& Insights (IP\&C)
   

  

 The candidate will contribute to the center’s research and thought leadership initiatives in the IP\&C sector, with a particular focus on topics such as digital transformation, workforce, supply chain resilience, sustainability, industrial technology, aerospace \& defense modernization, capital projects, data center construction, and other evolving industry issues. These deliverables integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources such as Deloitte subject matter experts, primary surveys, third\-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentary, and news articles.

 As an Analyst – Center for Energy \& Industrials – Research \& Insights (IP\&C) on the ER\&I research center team, you will be responsible for supporting projects that align with the research agenda in collaboration with the US\- and India\-based ER\&I team:

* Shall be able to identify and understand the technical details of various certificates and reports associated with Manufacturing Processes and Testing of materials.

* Shall be able to read, interpret \& make decision on acceptance of various reports as per the Industry and TechnipFMC standards/Engineering Requirements/Project Requirements.

* Shall have hands on experience on resolving Non\-Conformances.
* Shall have hands on experience in Quality \& Lean Tools for problem solving.
* Shall have Good Communication skills to work with Global Functional teams.
* Must be capable of demonstrating mentoring and training skills.
* Flexibility to work in different shifts based on the need (Global regions: US/ER).


 Major Responsibilities
   

  

* Compile Final Products Deliverable \- Manufacturing Record Books as per Customer/Project requirements.
* Perform Progressive Quality checks of Internal TechnipFMC Products Manufacturing reports according to engineering \& project requirements.
* Perform Final MRB Quality checks of TechnipFMC Products MRBs (Manufacturing Record Books) to authorize the shipment of parts according to engineering \& project requirements.
* Drives internal Non\-conformances report creation/coordination/closure through SAP/Intelex.
* Resolve non\-conformance findings by closely working with internal stakeholders (Plant Quality \& Project Quality).
* Drive Supplier/Internal Non\-conformances report through creation/coordination/closure of NCRs through SAP/Intelex.

* Execute root cause analysis (RCA). Work on Containment, Corrective \& Preventive Actions (CAPA) on identified process GAPs to meet the global procedure requirements.
* Investigate and address customer complaints and non\-conformances received from TPI.

 Quality Assurance
   

  

 API Testing
   

  

 General understand of industrial specification and Welding specification requirement

 Manufacturing Processes: Welding / NDE

Experience with delivering Technology and/or business solutions across industries, platforms, and/or lines of business (LOB) within the insurance and/or financial services industries. Demonstrated capability in managing the requirements lifecycle, including facilitation, elicitation, and documenting requirements.
   

  

**Technical Skills**

* Business Requirements
* Data Analysis
* Development Testing
* Problem Solving
* Requirements Gathering
* Systems Thinking
* Technical Acumen


**Soft Skills \& Attributes**
* Effective communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization
* Ability to influence, negotiate and set priorities needed. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

 Reports to Technology Leader – India

description:
**1\. Advance the Ambient Assessment strategy** 



* Translate the current Ambient Assessment vision brief into a structured, partner\-ready strategy package
* Document the signal architecture, signal validation criteria, and data design
* Develop a phased rollout plan with clear gates, dependencies, decision points, and success criteria
* Define the requirements needed to engage a strategic validation partner
* Maintain alignment with Talent Signature, the broader skills taxonomy, and the GLD Learning Strategy



**2\. Develop GLD Learning Strategy pillar documentation** 



* Draft, structure, and evidence\-base content for one or more strategy pillars: What we build, Who we develop, What we offer, and How we power it
* Translate senior strategic direction into structured pillar documentation
* Create supporting evidence, including frameworks, decision trees, taxonomies, and operating standards
* Maintain coherence and cross\-references across pillars



**3\. Shape the agentic content pipeline blueprint** 



* Define the blueprint for an AI and agentic content generation and transformation pipeline, from intake to publish
* Document design principles, governance, quality criteria, handoff standards, and review checkpoints
* Translate senior direction into a review\-ready blueprint that partner delivery teams can act on



**4\. Develop SNUx artifacts and supporting evidence** 



* Develop SNUx artifacts that articulate the future\-state learning vision — learner\-centred, AI\-native, enterprise\-ready
* Document the evidence base behind SNUx hypotheses through POCs, prototypes, and learner research
* Maintain SNUx as a living body of work, not a static deck



**5\. Translate senior direction into finished strategy artifacts** 



* Take strategic direction from senior LSI leadership and independently produce finished, review\-ready deliverables
* Operate in a high\-ambiguity, fast\-moving environment where strategy is being defined and documented in real time
* Maintain LSI’s evidence\-led, learner\-first, AI\-enabled standards in everything produced



**Success metrics** 



* Ambient Assessment strategy package completed for partner review, including signal architecture, validation criteria, phased rollout, and data design
* Agentic content pipeline blueprint drafted, structured, and ready for senior review
* At least one GLD Learning Strategy pillar advanced into structured, evidence\-based documentation
* SNUx artifacts and supporting evidence moved from concept\-level inputs to an organized, documented body of work
* Senior LSI capacity redirected from artifact production to direction\-setting, stakeholder alignment, and decision\-making



**Skills:** 




**Core skills** 



* **Strategic learning design:** 
 Ability to translate enterprise learning priorities into structured strategies, frameworks, and decision\-ready artifacts
* **AI\-enabled learning fluency:** 
 Working understanding of AI\-native learning models, personalization, adaptive pathways, agentic workflows, and emerging learning technologies
* **Assessment and skills measurement:** 
 Ability to define signals, validation criteria, success measures, and evidence models for skills\-based learning and ambient assessment
* **Systems thinking:** 
 Ability to connect learning science, AI capabilities, data design, governance, operational realities, and business outcomes
* **Strategic writing and synthesis:** 
 Strong ability to distill complex inputs into clear, structured, executive\-ready documents and partner\-facing materials
* **Stakeholder alignment:** 
 Ability to incorporate senior direction, partner requirements, and cross\-functional input while maintaining strategic coherence
* **Independent execution:** 
 Comfortable operating with ambiguity, limited supervision, and evolving direction in a fast\-moving strategy environment



**Preferred qualifications** 



* 5–7 years of experience in learning strategy, learning experience design, instructional design, or a closely related strategic learning role
* Demonstrated experience building strategy documents, frameworks, or methodologies independently — not just contributing to them
* Strong grounding in learning science, skills measurement, assessment design, or AI\-enabled learning strategy
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled learning concepts such as adaptive learning, signal\-based assessment, intelligent tutoring, and personalized learning paths

title: Associate Demo Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.
   

  

 Yext is looking for a curious, technology\-minded individual to join the Demo Engineering team as an
 **Associate Demo Engineer** 
 .
   

  

 This is a brilliant entry\-level opportunity for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, excited to learn, and keen to build a career at the intersection of AI, digital search, and sales enablement.The Demo Engineering team supports a wide range of internal partners — including Revenue (Sales and Solutions Engineering), Client Services, Marketing, and Product — by creating everything from polished standard demo environments to visionary "art of the possible" solutions that showcase what the Yext platform can do.
   

  

 As an Associate, you'll learn the craft of demo engineering from the ground up, working alongside experienced engineers and solutions professionals in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 This role is based in India and is designed to give you real, hands\-on experience from day one — with clear development pathways into a full Demo Engineer role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Supporting Demo Asset Creation, Development \& Deliverables**
* Support Senior Demo Engineers with delivering Demo Engineering requests. This will include assisting in building and maintaining standard demo environments using the Yext platform.
* Help customise demo accounts to reflect prospect\-specific use cases and industry contexts, guided by senior team members.
* Support updates to Knowledge Graph data, basic connector and crawler configurations, and front\-end elements.
* Help keep demo environments current with the latest Yext product features and configurations.


**Continuous Platform Learning \& Assistance of Deliverables**
* Continuously learn the Yext platform including Hearsay. Build a strong foundational understanding of the Yext platform, covering Listings, Search, Pages, and Knowledge Graph.
* Shadow Senior Demo Engineers and Solutions Engineers to learn how demos are scoped, built, and used throughout the sales cycle.
* Complete recommended certifications and participate in product enablement programmes.
* Learn SEO best practices and assist in assessing prospects' digital presence using these best practices, beginning to identify areas for improvement.
* Learn to understand the common data structures required to successfully support the generation of Yext Scout Reports.
* Learn to interpret Yext Analytics including Yext Scout.
* Learn to understand Yext Knowledge Scans; to evaluate a prospect's presence across digital Listings, user Reviews, and optimised web Pages.
* With guidance from Senior Demo Engineers, learn to prepare and support reports and materials to enable pre\-sales discussions led by Yext Global Solutions Engineers.
* Begin developing basic skills in HTML, CSS, and using AI tools (such as LLMs) to assist with front\-end customisation tasks.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Support the deal cycle by managing and responding to inbound requests from Solutions Engineers and Account Executives via Jira.
* Participate in scoping calls and team stand\-ups to develop an understanding of how work is prioritised.
* Stay close to product updates — including pre\-GA features — through internal channels and product communications.
* Share learnings and observations with the team via Slack and team meetings.
* Contribute to the SE Confluence knowledge hub by documenting what you've learnt, edge case handling, and useful guides for others.


**Operational Excellence**
* Keep your assigned Jira Tickets Demo up to date.
* Maintain and take responsibility for your allocated areas of the Demo Library.
* Follow team administration hygiene and ticketing standards so requests are tracked, prioritised, and delivered consistently.
* Be curious: ask questions proactively and surface blockers early — no one is expected to figure everything out alone.


**What You Have**
* A desire to develop a career in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role — relevant internships, placements, or academic projects are very welcome.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
* A basic awareness of HTML and CSS, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
* Clear, confident communication skills — you can explain ideas simply and work well with others.
* Genuine curiosity about technology, AI, and digital experiences.
* A coachable attitude and the motivation to grow quickly in a high\-performance environment
* The ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate across teams effectively.
* Curiosity; the default mindset to want to understand why technical aspects work, behave, evolve and the value it brings to Yext clients.


**Bonus Points**
* Previous experience in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role.
* Any exposure to SaaS platforms, CMS tools, Analytics platforms or digital marketing and SEO concepts.
* A passing familiarity with JavaScript or basic front\-end development.
* Some experience or interest in data, structured content, or database concepts.
* An interest in how technology supports pre\-sales and revenue teams.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* You'll work at the forefront of AI and digital search technology, gaining practical experience in one of the fastest\-evolving spaces in tech.
* You'll build real demo assets that directly support enterprise sales cycles — your work will matter from the start.
* You'll receive structured mentorship and development to help you grow into a full Demo Engineer role.
* You'll collaborate with talented Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, Field Marketing and Product teams across a global organisation.
* You'll develop highly practical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, the Yext platform, and AI tooling, Analytics — and learn how to apply them in a commercial context.


**Perks And Benefits**
 At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture.
   

  

**Benefits**
 We believe that people do their best when they feel their best — and to feel their best, they must be well\-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including:
   

  

* Performance\-Based Compensation: We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions.
* Comprehensive Leave Package: Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work\-life balance.
* Health \& Wellness Offerings: We provide medical insurance with 7L coverage, including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements).
* Relocation Benefits: We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition.
* World\-Class Office \& Building Amenities: Our office has a top\-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas.


 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.
   

  

 It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.

 All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. **Summary**

 Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research \& Insights (R\&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:
   

  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the TMT industry
* Provide practical and actionable insights \- whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the health and evolution of the TMT industry.
* Make extensive use of leading practices from TMT professionals across diverse disciplines, including content strategy, digital distribution, advertising and monetization, consumer analytics, rights management, finance, risk management, regulation, and human capital, to identify innovative steps they have taken to address critical challenges.


 Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here .
   

  

 This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub\-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
   

  

 The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought\-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in\-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data\-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject\-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third\-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
   

  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject\-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high\-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector\-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well\-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought\-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision\-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data\-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client\-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings


**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**
* 6\-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US\-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.


**Industry/sector/subsector skills**
* Business research/thought\-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI \[1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time\-to\-market, and fab efficiency.
* Familiarity with architectural innovation, heterogeneous compute. (CPU/GPU/NPU/memory/interconnects), chiplet\-based designs, co\-packaged optics, advanced chip packaging and their role in performance and cost curves.
* Awareness about strategic chokepoints and importance of supply chain resilience for hardware and semiconductor components; Geopolitical and operational risks in this space.
* Consumer and end\-user needs and attitudes towards AI and agent\-powered devices and applications for work, education, and personal reasons – including AI at the edge.


**Technical skills**
* Proficiency in using one or more of the research tools/databases, including S\&P Global, Factiva, Thomson Research, Refinitiv Workspace, and Gartner.
* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data\-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Problem\-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub\-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI\-based platforms and tools in a responsible and transparent way to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.

title: Founder's Office / Chief of Staff
description:
**About The Role**
 Techdome is hiring someone to operate as an extension of the CEO and CTO — turning high\-level strategic discussions into tangible, executed outcomes. This isn't a support role; it's a role built for someone who can take a half\-formed idea from a leadership conversation and walk out with a plan, a timeline, and a person accountable for each piece. You'll work across Engineering, Marketing, BD, and Ops to keep priorities moving from "we should do this" to "this is done," and you'll constantly be looking for places where AI and automation can replace manual, repetitive work across the business.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Translate strategic conversations with the CEO/CTO into concrete action items — clear owners, deadlines, and next steps
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives across Engineering, Marketing, BD, and Ops from kickoff to actual completion, not just status updates
* Catch operational bottlenecks early, before they escalate into urgent fire drills
* Create polished, client\-ready pitch decks, proposals, and briefing documents for founder\-led presentations
* Sit in on client and BD conversations and own the follow\-through as though the deal were yours
* Conduct market, competitor, and customer research and distill it into actionable recommendations
* Flag recurring manual work — research, reporting, documentation — and build AI\-driven or automated fixes for it
* Take on ad hoc, cross\-cutting projects that don't naturally belong to any single team


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\+ months of experience in a Founder's Office, BizOps, Strategy, BD, or early\-stage startup role
* A track record of operating effectively without a pre\-built playbook
* High ownership — you notice what's missing and fix it before someone has to ask
* Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, sometimes within the same week
* Solid skills in building sharp PowerPoint decks and Excel/Sheets\-based models
* Fluency in using AI tools as a natural part of daily work, not a bolt\-on
* Sound judgment around confidential information, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing track of details


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in a startup or founder's office, particularly under high\-pressure conditions
* Exposure to client\-facing work or business development
* Working familiarity with tools like Notion, Asana, or Trello
* Some understanding of how AI, SaaS, Healthcare, Fintech, or Enterprise Tech companies operate
* An MBA is a nice\-to\-have, but a demonstrated bias for execution matters far more


**Why Join Techdome?**
* End\-to\-end exposure to strategy, technology, AI, BD, client relationships, and operations — with genuine ownership, not a front\-row seat
* Direct, regular access to the CEO and CTO and a place in the room where real decisions get made
* Cross\-functional scope across the entire business — nothing pre\-packaged, nowhere to coast
* A clear growth path into a broader leadership or strategy role as you demonstrate impact


**What Success Looks Like**
 You'll know you're succeeding if strategic ideas consistently turn into finished outcomes on your watch — the right people get chased down, the right blockers get cleared, and nothing important slips through.

title: Associate Manager - Design
description:
Management Level: 8 \- Associate Manager \- Design
   

  

 Location: Open for PAN India
   

  

 Must have skills: Instructional Design, Content Development, E\-learning, Storyboarding, Learning Technologies.
   

  

 Good to have skills: Articulate 360, Canva/Vyond, LMS/LXP, AI in Learning, Learning Analytics.
   

  

 Experience: 8–12 years
   

  

 Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s/master's degree in education, Instructional Design, Technology, Management, or related field.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for an Associate Manager \- Design to design and develop engaging, learner\-centric, and outcome\-driven learning experiences across digital, blended, and instructor\-led formats. The role will focus on instructional design, content development, storyboarding, digital learning solutions, and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Design and develop end\-to\-end learning solutions, including learning objectives, curriculum mapping, storyboards, content, activities, assessments, and learner resources.
   

  

 Create engaging digital, e\-learning, blended, and instructor\-led content using instructional design principles and learning frameworks.
   

  

 Work closely with SMEs, faculty, instructional designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging, and learner\-friendly content.
   

  

 Develop and review content using Articulate 360, Vyond, Canva, and other digital learning tools, ensuring quality, consistency, and accessibility.
   

  

 Manage assigned design projects, timelines, reviews, and stakeholder feedback to ensure on\-time and high\-quality delivery.
   

  

 Use learner feedback, assessments, and basic learning analytics to continuously improve content effectiveness and learner engagement.
   

  

**Required Experience, Skills \& Qualifications**
 8–12 years of experience in instructional design, content development, digital learning, L\&D, EdTech, or education.
   

  

 Strong understanding of instructional design principles, curriculum development, e\-learning, blended learning, and adult learning.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience in storyboarding and content development using tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Canva, or similar platforms.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with SMEs, faculty, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to develop learning solutions.
   

  

 Strong ability to simplify complex concepts and create engaging, structured, and outcome\-focused learning content.
   

  

 Good project management, communication, presentation, review, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Exposure to LMS/LXP platforms, learning analytics, AI\-enabled learning, gamification, and emerging learning technologies is preferred.
   

  

**About Us**
 Backed by a $1 billion investment over three years, Accenture launched its LearnVantage business in March 2024, providing comprehensive learning and training services to help organizations reskill and upskill their people and achieve greater business results in the AI economy. Powered by an AI\-native platform, Accenture LearnVantage offers learning strategy and design, personalized learning experiences, learning managed services and certifications, all supported by a robust partner network and access to more than 2,000 mentors around the world. For more information, please visit www.accenture.com/learnvantage

 Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R\&D, Data \& Digital functions . * Support the execution of quality research projects, economic models, trial design recommendations and other activities in support of programs/products

* Technical skills: Strong analytical skills to translate clinical and economic information and messages into payer evidence strategies; Understands reimbursement decisions to determine value drivers and how evidence is used in decision making and how it impacts various payers (e.g., providers, patients, health systems); Knowledge of methods and principles of health economics, health technology assessment (HTA) reviews
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree

title: Senior Program Specialist
description:
**Description**
 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Verification Programs Coordinator is an individual contributor role within the Programs, Regional Operations and Strategy (PROpS) Division, reporting to the Senior Manager, Market Development, Verification Programs. This position is responsible for supporting the operational execution and administrative management of USP’s Verification Programs. The role drives coordination of projects, tools, and processes that enhance visibility into the program pipeline. Key responsibilities also include data management, reporting optimization, performance metric tracking, and preparation and distribution of internal reports. In addition, the position contributes to broader program operations and continuous improvement initiatives that support the effectiveness and growth of the Verification Program.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Verification Programs Coordinator Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Verification staff and other stakeholders to coordinate and facilitate project activities, including but not limited to:
* Tracking and reporting on marketing and business performance
* Scheduling of project meetings and production of supporting materials
* Action item and records management
* Developing processes, reports, and presentations to drive overall operation excellence using USP tools (e.g. Salesforce, Tableau, Jira, Adobe, etc.)
* Manage systems and process\-related projects aimed at driving visibility and accountability for program performance related to existing and new customers
* Assist in revenue and invoice tracking to ensure accuracy and timely reporting
* Track data from multiple sources, provide data entry for various systems, and develop reports and queries for systems supporting pipeline management
* Prepare reporting documents and presentations by assigned deadlines
* Actively contribute to Verification Program projects and initiatives
* Assist in capturing customer call reports and action items within CRM platform
* Facilitate group interactions through interpersonal and tool\-based skills to achieve project goals
* Work with management and coworkers to develop, improve, and standardize project\-related processes
* Support cross\-departmental and cross\-divisional activities, as related to assigned projects
* Recognize and escalate issues that potentially require upper management awareness and input
* Secure services as needed from other departmental, divisional, and organizational groups
* Help with special projects upon request
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned


**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Required Qualifications**
 The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience with a combination of relevant project management skills and/or scientific background.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work across teams in a matrixed environment
* Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and efficiently manage multiple projects
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Advanced computer competence (MS Office, MS Teams, MS Project, Sharepoint, Copilot, etc.)


**Additional Desired Competencies**
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or relevant professional experience
* Experience with analytical data platforms (e.g. Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce)
* Self\-motivated and results\-oriented
* Demonstrated ability to mobilize stakeholders towards results
* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed
* High comfort with navigating through ambiguity and change
* Strong time management skills
* Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and team\-building skills
* Excellent critical thinking and critical thinking skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent presentation and reporting skills
* Knowledge of USP products and services
* Experience with certification or audit programs
* Able to work flexible hours when needed in collaboration with global teams


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 None, this is an individual contributor role.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job\-related reasons.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Project Management
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time
