title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
description:
**Job Description**
 Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Define end\-to\-end requirements for the build of an agentic solution for the data persona that enables end\-to\-end data product development, in alignment with firmwide data guidelines and standards.
* Lead discovery with business teams to document current workflows, identify friction points, and translate needs into a prioritized intake backlog. Also demonstrate how the agent addresses these pain points.
* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.
* Validate delivered capabilities by reviewing agent behaviors, generated outputs, and integrated workflows to ensure they match intent and agreed standards.
* Define and track acceptance criteria, success metrics, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., agent task\-completion rate, output quality, human\-in\-the\-loop intervention rate) for each capability release.Coordinate delivery execution through backlog refinement, sprint planning support, release readiness checks, and dependency management across teams.
* Contribute to the multi\-year roadmap for scaling the agentic tool from PoC to a firmwide platform – including capability expansion, LOB onboarding sequencing, and platform hardening.
* Develop a working point of view on the target agentic architecture: orchestration patterns, scheduling, agent\-to\-agent communication, memory/state management, tool registries, and evaluation infrastructure.
* Identify reusable components, shared services, and integration points with existing firmwide data platforms and skills repositories.
* Partner with governance, risk, controls, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure responsible use and appropriate controls are embedded into the solution. Collaborate and align with data engineers, data scientists, product managers, architects, and technology partners to achieve business outcomes.
* Drive coordination and communication with senior stakeholders to advance the DDLC strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship. Produce executive\-ready materials: roadmap updates, PoC readouts, adoption metrics, and business\-value narratives.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Demonstrated understanding of agentic artificial intelligence patterns, including single\-agent, multi\-agent, and orchestrated approaches.
* Working knowledge of generative artificial intelligence building blocks, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, context design, evaluation methods, and safety controls.
* Hands\-on experience using modern generative artificial intelligence development tools (for example, enterprise\-approved coding assistants or agent\-enabled integrated development environments).
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including deployment pipelines, continuous integration and continuous delivery, environment promotion, testing strategies, and observability.
* Working knowledge of the data development lifecycle, including data modeling, schema and contract design, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and publishing standards.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical work items, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience running pilots in a large, regulated enterprise environment, including stakeholder alignment and release discipline.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect senior stakeholder priorities to engineering execution.
* Track record of end\-to\-end delivery in data, data science, or data product work in consulting or internal consulting contexts.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.
* Familiarity with evaluation operations for generative artificial intelligence (for example, test harnesses, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices).
* Advanced degree in a quantitative, computer science, or data\-related discipline.
* Familiarity with financial services environments, including operating in control\-conscious delivery models.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

title: Technical Content Marketer
description:
**Technical Content Marketer** 




  





**About Deccan AI** 




 Deccan AI is a Bay Area\-based data infrastructure company. We help frontier labs and enterprises with model training, fine\-tuning, and reliable AI deployment. We've raised a $25M Series A, and our customers include Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Snowflake, and several of the world's leading frontier labs, neo labs and enterprises.
 



  





**The role** 




 We write for researchers at frontier AI labs and for AI and ML leaders at large enterprises. They're technical readers, and they expect content that gets the details right without sounding like jargon soup.
 



 You'll turn our research, product capabilities and customer outcomes into content these readers find useful. You'll work closely with product marketing, our research team and the founders, and you'll have room to carve a unique voice for Deccan AI in the market.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Distribution:** 
 Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* **Long\-form TOFU pieces:** 
 Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write\-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* **BOFU content:** 
 Create landing pages, one\-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite.Write landing pages, one\-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* **SEO and AEO:** 
 Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* **Social media:** 
 Plan and write content for Deccan's LinkedIn, X, and more.
* **Strategic case studies:** 
 Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose Deccan and what it changed for them.
* **Launches and announcements:** 
 Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.



  





**You'll do well here if you** 



* **Shun AI slop:** 
 You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.
* **Pick up deep technical topics quickly:** 
 You need curiosity and the patience to ask experts good questions until you understand the subject well enough to explain it.
* **Bring a point of view:** 
 You enjoy forming opinions about the industry and backing them up in writing.
* **Obsess over quality:** 
 You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.
* **Measure your work by results.** 
 You want to know whether a piece brought in traffic, leads or conversations, and you use that to decide what to write next.
* **Use AI tools well.** 
 You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* **Enjoy collaboration:** 
 You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.



  





**Experience** 



* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.
* A portfolio of your published writing for different channels
* Hands\-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.



 If your experience falls slightly outside this range but your work makes the case, apply anyway.
 



  





**Bonus points** 



* You've written about AI, data or developer tools.
* You've written for formats beyond text, like video scripting or visual content.



  





**Why Deccan AI?** 



* **High ownership:** 
 You'll own how Deccan AI's story reaches the market across the channels.
* **Flat hierarchy:** 
 We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:** 
 We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward:** 
 You'll have real room to experiment with AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.



  





**How to apply** 




 Send your resume along with two or three published pieces you wrote yourself. Add a line on each about what it achieved.

title: AI Knowledge Analyst I
description:
**Role Summary**
 The AI Knowledge Analyst is a member of the Customer Care and Managed Services team, responsible for ensuring the knowledge ecosystems that power GHX's operations and AI platforms are accurate, well\-governed, and continuously improving. This role works closely with leadership, SMEs, data scientists, and operational teams to identify content gaps, manage knowledge lifecycles, and translate business needs into structured, AI\-ready information assets. The AI Knowledge Analyst is equally comfortable working through a detailed content audit and presenting a structured recommendation to leadership. Strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a bias for action are required. This is a role for someone who treats knowledge gaps as solvable problems and can move from gap identification to resolution with minimal direction.
   

  

**Core Focus Areas**
**Knowledge Governance \& Lifecycle Management**
 Maintain, organize, and govern the knowledge assets that support Customer Care and Managed Services teams. This includes managing intake, triage, and routing of knowledge requests; driving SME review cycles; and ensuring content is accurate, current, and ready for both human use and AI ingestion.
   

  

**AI Knowledge Readiness**
 Identify, structure, and groom content that feeds GHX's AI platform. Partner with AI and data teams to ensure knowledge assets are formatted, accurate, and optimized for ingestion. Monitor AI solution performance and drive content improvements that translate into measurable efficiency gains.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Management \& Content Quality**
* Manage the intake, triage, and routing of knowledge\-related requests from operational teams.
* Maintain content lifecycle through SME review checkpoints — flagging material for update, review, or archival on a consistent cadence.
* Identify obsolete, duplicate, or conflicting content and drive resolution through appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct knowledge audits and implement improvement cycles based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.
* Translate operational knowledge into structured, AI\-ingestible formats ensuring accuracy, consistency, and taxonomy compliance.


**AI Knowledge Readiness \& Technology**
* Structure and groom knowledge content for ingestion into GHX's AI platforms; ensure format, tagging, and taxonomy standards are met.
* Monitor AI platform performance related to knowledge quality; recommend and track content\-driven improvements.
* Partner with data scientists and AI developers to understand ingestion requirements and close content gaps.
* Stay current on trends in AI knowledge management, large language model content requirements, and KM tooling.


**Process Improvement \& Analysis**
* Analyze and document knowledge workflows, identifying gaps or structural issues that reduce content usability or AI accuracy.
* Interpret usage data, feedback trends, and engagement metrics to recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of governance standards, taxonomy structures, and documentation templates.
* Learn and apply Lean/Six Sigma and knowledge\-centered service (KCS) frameworks where applicable.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Partner with SMEs, operational leaders, and AI teams to promote adoption of AI\-enabled knowledge systems.
* Provide end\-user training and support on knowledge tools, systems, and updated content resources.
* Collect stakeholder requirements and develop content solutions that meet operational team needs.
* Present knowledge health findings and recommendations to leadership with clear next steps.


**Required Skills**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor message by audience.
* Familiarity with knowledge management systems (Confluence/Atlassian, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret usage data and translate findings into action.
* Detail\-oriented with ability to manage multiple knowledge domains and adjust priorities as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Forms); CRM familiarity a plus (Salesforce preferred).
* Self\-directed learner who identifies gaps and takes initiative to close them.
* Understanding of how content structure and taxonomy affect AI/ML model performance preferred.


**Education \& Experience**
* 2\+ years of related experience in knowledge management, operations enablement, content governance, or business analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining content for both human consumption (training, SOPs) and machine ingestion (AI platforms, knowledge bases).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Organizational Development, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Change management or KM certification (Prosci, KCS, ACMP) a plus.

title: Regulatory Labeling Mgr
description:
**Overview**
 Regulatory Labeling Manager will support the planning, coordination, and execution of EU and global labelling compliance activities within the Regulatory Affairs organisation. This role will support end\-to\-end labelling activities, including Product Information updates, linguistic review, mock\-up coordination, artwork review, approval workflows, and implementation of approved labelling changes.
   

  

 Working in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment with no direct reports, the role will collaborate closely with global, regional, and local Regulatory Affairs teams, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, affiliates, and external vendors. The position requires strong attention to detail, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate multiple labelling deliverables across markets, timelines, and functions.
   

  

 This role provides an opportunity to contribute to EU labelling activities, support inspection readiness, strengthen labelling processes, and ensure that Product Information, packaging components, and artwork are maintained in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, approved Marketing Authorisations, and internal quality standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Labelling Compliance and Change Management


 Coordinate day\-to\-day labelling activities to support timely and compliant implementation of approved labelling changes across EU and global markets.
   

  

 Manage labelling change requests, track deliverables, monitor timelines, and maintain accurate records in applicable labelling, artwork, or document management systems.
   

  

 Serve as an operational point of contact for labelling activities, providing guidance to internal stakeholders on labelling processes, document requirements, formats, and timelines.
   

  

 Ensure labelling updates are aligned with approved Product Information, internal procedures, quality standards, and market\-specific implementation requirements.
   

  

 Identify potential compliance risks, delays, inconsistencies, or documentation gaps and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for timely resolution.
   

  

* EU Labelling Process and Product Information Coordination


 Support EU labelling activities across applicable procedures, including centralised, decentralised, mutual recognition, and national procedures, as relevant.
   

  

 Coordinate updates to EU Product Information components, including the Summary of Product Characteristics, Package Leaflet, outer labelling, inner labelling, mock\-ups, and related packaging text.
   

  

 Support alignment of labelling content with approved Marketing Authorisations, regulatory commitments, internal procedures, and country\-specific requirements.
   

  

 Coordinate with regional and local Regulatory Affairs contacts to gather requirements, clarify expectations, resolve queries, and support implementation of approved labelling changes.
   

  

 Track EU labelling milestones, review comments, approvals, and implementation status to ensure visibility across stakeholders and support delivery against agreed timelines.
   

  

* Linguistic Review Coordination


 Facilitate linguistic review activities for EU labelling updates, working with affiliates, local regulatory contacts, translation vendors, and internal reviewers.
   

  

 Coordinate the review of country\-specific translations to support consistency, accuracy, and alignment with approved source Product Information.
   

  

 Track linguistic review comments, queries, responses, and approvals to ensure timely completion of country\-specific labelling requirements.
   

  

 Support resolution of translation queries, terminology discrepancies, formatting issues, and Member State or local affiliate comments in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 Maintain accurate documentation of linguistic review activities, decisions, approvals, and final approved local texts in applicable systems.
   

  

* Artwork Review, Approval, and Implementation


 Coordinate artwork review and approval workflows to ensure packaging components accurately reflect approved labelling text, technical requirements, and market\-specific information.
   

  

 Support review of artwork components, including cartons, labels, leaflets, blisters, foils, and other printed packaging materials, as applicable.
   

  

 Collaborate with artwork vendors, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and local affiliates to support timely artwork creation, review, approval, release, and implementation.
   

  

 Review artwork\-related documentation for completeness, consistency, version control, and alignment with approved Product Information and internal procedures.
   

  

 Monitor artwork timelines and proactively follow up with stakeholders to address delays, open comments, approval bottlenecks, or implementation risks.
   

  

 Maintain accurate records of artwork decisions, review comments, approvals, version history, and implementation evidence in relevant systems.
   

  

* Cross\-functional and Vendor Coordination


 Partner with global, regional, and local stakeholders across Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and affiliates to support compliant and timely labelling implementation.
   

  

 Coordinate with external vendors, including translation providers and artwork vendors, to ensure deliverables meet agreed quality expectations, timelines, and service\-level requirements.
   

  

 Assist in monitoring vendor performance, identifying service gaps, and escalating issues that may impact labelling compliance, linguistic review, artwork approval, or implementation timelines.
   

  

 Participate in project meetings with internal and external partners to align on priorities, clarify requirements, resolve operational challenges, and drive completion of milestones.
   

  

 Support effective collaboration across time zones by maintaining clear communication, structured follow\-up, and accurate tracking of open actions.
   

  

* Process Improvement, Inspection Readiness, and Knowledge Sharing


 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on labelling processes, EU labelling workflows, linguistic review coordination, artwork review, templates, trackers, and system usage.
   

  

 Support inspection readiness by ensuring labelling documentation, approval records, SOP adherence, and implementation evidence are complete, accurate, and readily available.
   

  

 Collect and analyse labelling operations data to identify trends, process gaps, cycle\-time delays, and opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and transparency.
   

  

 Assist in developing or refining training materials, job aids, process maps, and work instructions to promote consistent execution of labelling procedures.
   

  

 Provide guidance and operational support to peers and junior team members on labelling compliance processes, EU labelling requirements, artwork review, linguistic review, and quality expectations.
   

  

 Stay informed of emerging EU labelling expectations, regulatory requirements, and industry practices that may impact Product Information, artwork processes, or labelling implementation activities.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree with 9 to 12 years of directly related experience in Regulatory Affairs, labelling compliance, artwork management, quality, or a related pharmaceutical or biotechnology function.
   

  

 Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may also be considered.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience supporting EU and/or global labelling processes, including Product Information updates, linguistic review, mock\-up review, artwork review, approval workflows, and implementation activities.
   

  

 Familiarity with EU labelling requirements, approved Product Information, country\-specific implementation needs, and coordination with regional affiliates or local regulatory contacts.
   

  

 Experience working with labelling management systems, artwork management systems, or document management platforms such as Veeva Vault or similar tools.
   

  

 Understanding of end\-to\-end labelling implementation, from approved regulatory text through translation, linguistic review, artwork creation, review, approval, release, and market implementation.
   

  

 Experience coordinating Summary of Product Characteristics, Package Leaflet, outer labelling, inner labelling, mock\-ups, and printed packaging components.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to manage multiple labelling deliverables in a matrix organisation while meeting deadlines and maintaining compliance.
   

  

 Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across international teams, external vendors, and multiple time zones.
   

  

 Experience coordinating with translation vendors, artwork vendors, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and regional or local stakeholders.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify risks, gaps, inconsistencies, or discrepancies in labelling documentation.
   

  

 Ability to support process improvement initiatives and contribute to efficient, compliant, and scalable labelling workflows.
   

  

 Familiarity with inspection readiness expectations, SOP compliance, documentation standards, quality\-controlled processes, and audit\-ready record maintenance.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Designation: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad (On\-site)
   

  

 At Aodh Lifesciences, we are building a next\-generation deep science drug development company focused on redefining respiratory drug delivery through a regulatory\-driven approach. Our work integrates translational biology, microbiology, advanced formulation and device engineering, PBPK modelling, IVIVC modelling, and regulatory\-grade data generation to develop targeted therapies designed to improve local efficacy while minimizing systemic exposure and addressing antimicrobial resistance.
   

  

 We are looking for driven individuals who are curious, think deeply about the science, and are excited to take ownership in a zero\-to\-one environment, building not just products but a globally relevant, regulatory\-grade R\&D ecosystem from the ground up.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Regulatory Specialist coordinates regulatory documentation, owning the end\-to\-end process of converting sourced data into compliant regulatory narrative documents. It coordinates the authoring workflow, manages documentation quality, and ensures every deliverable is correctly formatted, aligned, and submission\-ready. As and when required, deficiency has to be addressed based on regulatory responses.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Act as the single point of contact between the department (the authors) and the regulatory documentation pipeline.
   

  

 Issue authoring assignments to the appropriate departments based on document type and scope.
   

  

 Ensure timelines are met.
   

  

 Maintain a tracking system (assignments, due dates, revision cycles, sign\-off status).
   

  

 Escalate delays, gaps, or ambiguities in scope to the reporting manager/CEO in a timely manner.
   

  

 Collate compile \& analyse source data \& author into CTD granularity
   

  

 Ensure each authored narrative complies with applicable regulatory standards (ICH, CDSCO, FDA, EMA, as applicable)
   

  

 Ensure narrative documents accurately reflect the underlying signed source content without introducing interpretive changes.
   

  

 Review the regulatory readiness of the submission documents received from different stakeholders.
   

  

 Maintain complete traceability of all documentation.
   

  

 Follow ALCOA\+ guidelines and maintain document lifecycle.
   

  

 Apply QA principles to verify completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance of all documents.
   

  

 Conduct QC checks: cross\-reference verification, data consistency between source and narrative, citation accuracy, and adherence to templates.
   

  

 Ensure documents comply with applicable regulatory frameworks and internal SOPs.
   

  

 Coordinate with department consultants, subject matter experts, QA, and Regulatory Affairs leadership during review and approval cycles.
   

  

 Consolidate review comments, route them to the appropriate authors, and verify resolution before finalization.
   

  

 Facilitate and conduct Management Review Meeting (MRM)
   

  

 Qualification: 1 \- 3 years experience in quality assurance, Freshers with relevant knowledge can also apply.

description:
Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Area**
**Details**
**Supplier Catalog Enablement**
* Support supplier onboarding and enablement into the SAP Ariba catalog environment, including supplier Ariba Network relationship setup and registration coordination.
* Manage catalog implementation projects across categories and regions for PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalogs.
* Coordinate with suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data teams to resolve missing information and enable go\-live readiness.
* Maintain implementation trackers, action logs, risks, dependencies, and escalation visibility.


**Catalog Configuration, Administration \& Issue Resolution**
* Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.
* Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.
* Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.


**Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support**
* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go\-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.


**Catalog Adoption, Reporting \& Governance**
* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4\+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue\-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project\-tracking skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared\-services model supporting multi\-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.


 Success Measures / KPIs
   

  

* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On\-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go\-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non\-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.


 Key Stakeholders
   

  

* Procurement Operations and Global SCM CoE
* Category Management and Regional Procurement teams
* Digital / IT / SAP Ariba support teams
* Supplier Enablement, Master Data, Contracts, and Suppliers
* Business requesters and approvers across global regions

title: ServiceNow- Process Mapping & Automation - Assistant Vice President
description:
****Job Description****
 Job Description
   

  

****Role Summary \& Role Description****
 The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.
   

  

 This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.
   

  

**Service Mapping \& CMDB Management**
* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top\-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.


**Governance, BAU, Compliance \& Automation**
* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.


****Core/Must Have Skills****
 Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).
   

  

 Experience with tag\-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.
   

  

 Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).
   

  

 Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

****Good To Have Skills****
 ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)
   

  

 Familiarity with improving mapping outcomes through pattern optimization or extension concepts (where applicable)
   

  

 Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.
   

  

**Work Schedule**
 Hybrid
   

  

**Keywords (If any)**
 Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery
   

  

**Location**
 Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune

title: Senior Knowledge Engineer, AI Enablement & Knowledge Systems
description:
We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Engineer to join the Value \& Impact Management team within Customer Support. You will work in a high\-performing, highly collaborative environment, partnering across Support, Product, Operations, and Technology teams to improve how knowledge is created, maintained, shared, and utilized.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring Blackbaud's knowledge ecosystem effectively powers customers, support professionals, self\-service experiences, and AI\-enabled support capabilities. As Customer Support continues evolving toward more AI\-assisted, self\-service, and agentic support experiences, you will help ensure knowledge is accurate, discoverable, trusted, and structured for both human and AI consumption. You will serve as the bridge between knowledge strategy, digital experiences, and AI enablement, ensuring knowledge is optimized to support scalable resolution across every support channel. Based on the evolution of AI and knowledge management within Customer Support, knowledge quality, governance, retrieval, and usability are increasingly foundational to AI effectiveness and support outcomes.
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured not only by the health of knowledge assets, but by the effectiveness of the customer, support professional, self\-service, and AI experiences that depend upon them.
   

  

**Work Location and Schedue:**
**Work Location:** 
 Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India

* Ability to work a schedule aligned with U.S. business hours, generally 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), including participation in meetings, consultations, and other business\-critical activities during that time.
* Limited holiday coverage may be required based on business needs.


 What You'll Do
   

  

 Knowledge Strategy \& Governance
   

  

 Design and optimize the knowledge ecosystem that supports customers, support professionals, self\-service experiences, and AI\-enabled support capabilities.
   

  

 Define and maintain content standards, governance practices, taxonomy, and lifecycle management processes.
   

  

 Ensure knowledge remains accurate, trusted, discoverable, and reusable across support channels and experiences.

 AI Enablement \& Knowledge Systems
   

  

 Ensure knowledge systems are structured and optimized to power AI assistants, copilots, self\-service experiences, and agentic workflows.
   

  

 Partner with Operations, AI, and Technology teams to improve AI performance through effective knowledge design, retrieval, and governance
   

  

 Define standards for AI\-ready knowledge, including content structure, retrieval quality, and response accuracy.
   

  

 Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI to improve knowledge creation, maintenance, and discovery.
   

  

 Measurement, Validation \& Readiness
   

  

 Develop and use measurement tools to monitor knowledge health, self\-service success, and AI effectiveness.
   

  

 Analyze trends, usage patterns, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
   

  

 Validate knowledge readiness for product releases, process changes, and AI\-enabled experiences through testing and content gap analysis.
   

  

 Partner with stakeholders to identify risks, improve quality, and drive continuous improvement.
   

  

 Partnership \& Enablement
   

  

 Act as a steward of the Customer Support knowledge ecosystem, influencing how knowledge is created, maintained, shared, and consumed across teams and platforms.
   

  

 Partner across Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Technology teams to improve customer and employee experiences.
   

  

 Advocate for knowledge\-first and AI\-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes.
   

  

 Serve as a trusted subject matter expert on knowledge strategy, self\-service, and AI\-enabled support capabilities.
   

  

 What you’ll bring
   

  

 3\+ years of experience in knowledge management, content strategy, self\-service, customer support operations, or a related field, ideally within a support or service organization.
   

  

 Experience with knowledge management platforms or systems that support search, self\-service, AI assistants, copilots, or automated workflows.
   

  

 Salesforce Administrator and/or Agentforce Specialist certification preferred.
   

  

 Experience creating and maintaining content standards, taxonomy, governance practices, and content lifecycle processes.
   

  

 Familiarity with AI concepts such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, knowledge retrieval, evaluation, or AI governance.
   

  

 Experience using data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and drive improvements.
   

  

 Ability to translate complex information into clear, usable content, processes, and guidance for diverse audiences.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills, including the ability to build or interpret frameworks, business requirements, success measures, and readiness criteria.
   

  

 Proven ability to influence without authority and successfully partner across Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Technology teams.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience delivering training, enablement, or change adoption initiatives.
   

  

 Curious, adaptable, and energized by emerging technologies and evolving customer expectations.
   

  

 Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube
   

  

 Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our

* Exhibit exemplary teamwork, marked by effective communication, empathy, and solution\-oriented approaches.

title: Quality Lead
description:
**Location:** 

 Leanwatts Product HQ, Hyderabad, India
 




  





**About Us:** 




 At Leanwatts, we are focused on developing innovative power electronic solutions for electric vehicles (EVs) and Battery storage systems through continuous research and development. Our commitment to excellence and a “Designed and Made in India” ethos drives us to create and deliver sustainable products for the future of transportation.
 

  





**About the Role:** 




  






 We are looking for a Quality Lead to lead Leanwatts'
 
**Customer Quality, Field Quality and Warranty processes** 

 .
 





 The role will establish, implement and maintain quality systems capable of meeting IATF 16949 expectations, while ensuring consistent product quality and customer satisfaction across:
 



* 2W / 3W EV chargers and onboard charging products
* DC fast\-charging power modules and converters
* Hybrid inverters, PCS and energy products
* Future Leanwatts integrated power\-electronics platforms




 You will own the quality system from incoming/internal process controls through final inspection, customer documentation, audits, complaint closure and continuous improvement. Supplier and sub\-supplier audits are outside the scope of this role for now.
 




  





**What will You do:** 




  




* Own internal line quality across assembly, testing, rework and final inspection, including line controls, quality gates and escalation mechanisms.
* Establish and maintain Leanwatts' Quality Management System and processes required to progressively meet IATF 16949 requirements.
* Define and maintain process quality documentation including PFMEA, control plans, work instructions, inspection standards, check sheets and traceability requirements.
* Drive layered process audits, internal quality audits, process compliance reviews and closure of internal non\-conformities and CAPA.
* Work closely with R\&D, Manufacturing, Service and Supply Chain to eliminate recurring defects and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Own customer quality expectations, customer complaints, escalation discipline, 8D/CAPA responses and communication with customer engineering and quality teams.
* Manage customer audits and quality reviews, including audit preparation, evidence, corrective actions and closure of observations.
* Own PPAP/APQP and customer\-specific quality documentation, submissions, change\-control records and production\-part approval readiness.
* Track internal and customer quality metrics including first\-pass yield, rejection/rework, PPM, customer complaints, warranty/returns, repeat defects and CAPA ageing.
* Lead quality readiness for new product introduction, pilot builds and production ramp\-up, ensuring controls are established before release.
* Build a disciplined quality culture through daily/weekly reviews, defect containment, root\-cause problem solving, lessons learned and sustained corrective\-action verification.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  




* **Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Automotive, Mechatronics, Quality Engineering or a related field.**
* **Minimum 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, process quality, customer quality or plant quality roles in automotive/electronics manufacturing.**
* Strong hands\-on experience managing shop\-floor/line quality teams, non\-conformance control, CAPA and production quality systems.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining an automotive\-style QMS, preferably in an IATF 16949 environment or IATF readiness program.
* Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, 8D, 5\-Why, CAPA and internal/process audits.
* Strong customer\-facing communication and documentation skills, including handling customer audits, PPAP submissions, quality escalations and closure commitments.
* Ability to interpret drawings, test data, process/test logs and failure evidence and work effectively with engineering and manufacturing teams.
* Experience in EV, automotive electronics, power electronics, chargers, inverters, BESS or other high\-volume electronic manufacturing is preferred.





 ﻿
 





**What Success look like:** 




  






 You build and sustain a quality system that repeatedly delivers:
 




**Process Control → Defect Prevention → Audit Readiness → Customer Approval → Corrective Action → Sustained Improvement** 





 with stable line quality, IATF\-ready systems, strong customer audit/PPAP performance, lower defects and repeat failures, and consistently reliable production output.

title: Alpha Business Process Engineer, Officer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a hands\-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end — understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future\-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery\-focused, comfortable working directly with subject\-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future\-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
 Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
   

  

 We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible\-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject\-matter experts.
* Own end\-to\-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future\-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Map and assess current\-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction.
* Design simpler, standardized future\-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI.
* Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable.
* Validate process and knowledge assets with subject\-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control.
* Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures.
* Turn approved future\-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams.
* Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time.
* Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management.


**What We Value**
* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self\-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow\-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject\-matter experts and global stakeholders.


**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.
* Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial.
* Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable.
* Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast\-moving programme environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Process excellence or automation certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage.


**Interested but do not meet every qualification?** 
 If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team.
   

  

**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. **Technical Analyst, Specialist (R2\)**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. **Role Overview**
 Join a global Digital Manufacturing organization and contribute to digital capabilities supporting Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, and Environment, Health \& Safety.

**Incident \& Ticket Management**

**Data Management \& Quality Assurance**

* Help maintain data integrity across Enablon modules.
* Participate in reporting and analysis activities as needed.


**Release \& Change Support**

* Execute test cases and document testing results.
* Support post\-release validation and issue monitoring.

**Documentation \& Process Improvement**

* Author and maintain support documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles.
* Contribute to knowledge articles, job aids, troubleshooting guides and user support materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve support processes and operational efficiency.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Collaborate with business users, project teams, and technical resources to support application needs.
* Participate in support meetings, status updates, and project discussions.
* Escalate risks, issues, and blockers appropriately.


**Primary Skills**
**What You Should Have**
* Enterprise application administration, configuration, implementation of enhancements, and periodic upgrades.
* Hands on experience supporting configurable business applications, with exposure to variety of applications in Environmental Health \& Safety including Enablon.
* Ability to quickly learn, adopt, and support new technologies and applications across Product Line.
* Demonstrated experience across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, testing, deployment, validation, and support.
* Power BI development, reporting, and analytics.
* SQL and data analysis for troubleshooting, validation, and reporting.
* Understanding of workflows, business rules, forms, notifications, security models, and application configuration concepts.
* Incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution.
* Experience working with ticketing systems, support processes, and service management practices.
* Application testing, validation, and release support.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, system integrations, data management, data quality, and governance.
* Strong stakeholder communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Based in Hyderabad or Pune with flexibility for occasional CST overlap meetings.
* 3\-5 years of experience supporting enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with Enablon modules and configuration concepts.
* Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge for data analysis and validation.
* Experience with application testing and defect management.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience supporting Environmental, Health \& Safety (EHS) applications.
* Exposure to Enablon implementations or post\-production support.
* Experience working with global support teams.
* Familiarity with reporting tools such as Power BI.
* Experience creating user documentation, knowledge articles, or training materials.
* Knowledge of GxP/GMP environments, Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer System Assurance (CSA), and regulated manufacturing processes.


**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to JavaScript, web technologies, or application configuration tools.
* Experience with ETL or data\-loading activities.
* Enablon training or platform certification.
* Familiarity with Agile or ITIL\-based support processes.


**Working Hours \& Expectations**
* Core role follows Monday\-Friday India business hours.
* Flexibility for occasional meetings with global stakeholders.
* Participation in release activities and critical issue support when required.


**Performance Measures**
* Timely resolution of support tickets within agreed SLAs.
* Quality and accuracy of configuration and testing activities.

* Compliance with release and change management processes.
* Quality of support documentation and knowledge\-sharing contributions.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and collaboration effectiveness.
* Continuous development of platform knowledge and technical skills.

 𝟮. 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘂𝗲 \& 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗗𝗼𝗰𝘂𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻
 



 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗺𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶\-𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘂𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴:

 𝟯. 𝗕𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱\-𝗦𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁

 Objective: Ensure every MIIGO asset looks unmistakably MIIGO.
 



  





 𝟰. 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗜𝗺𝗮𝗴𝗲 \& 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
 



 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗜𝗜𝗚𝗢 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗽𝗵𝗼𝘁𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗽𝗵𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘃𝗶𝘀𝘂𝗮𝗹𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿:
 



  





 Image cleanup, background removal, retouching, perspective/lighting correction, shadows, application scenes, technical callouts, product\-feature close\-ups, website graphics, and exploded/technical visualisations.
 



  





 Technical integrity is mandatory: Product geometry, connectors, displays, labels, proportions, and engineering attributes must never be altered inaccurately.
 



  





 𝟱. 𝗩𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗼 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 \& 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴
 



 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹:
 



  





 Product\-introduction/feature videos, application videos, technical explainers, demonstration videos, software walkthroughs, installation/training videos, LinkedIn reels, YouTube content, exhibition videos, distributor presentations, and corporate films.
 



  





 Competencies: Storyboarding, scene sequencing, professional editing, motion graphics, kinetic typography, product callouts, subtitles, VO sync, music/SFX, audio balancing, color grading, screen recordings, logo animation, and multi\-format exports.
 



  





 𝟲. 𝗔𝗜\-𝗔𝘀𝘀𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
 



 𝗨𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲 𝗔𝗜 𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗼𝗿:
 



  





 Concept generation, storyboarding, background generation, image enhancement, product\-environment concepts, AI video/B\-roll generation, image\-to\-video, generative fill, object removal, voice generation, avatar presentations, script development, and motion concepts.
 



  





 Human judgment: Must identify and correct AI\-generated visual, technical, anatomical, branding, and product representation errors prior to publication.
 



  





 Preferred Tools \& Tech Stack
 



 Graphic Design / Publishing: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Lightroom, Affinity Designer, Affinity Photo, Affinity Publisher, Canva Pro. (InDesign or Affinity Publisher experience strongly preferred).

 Skills We Value

 Brand\-system thinking, professional image retouching, video editing, storyboarding, motion graphics, and AI workflows.
 



  





 High attention to detail, asset organization, version control, and the ability to independently elevate weak concepts.
 



  





 Technical Understanding Matters

 Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Business Systems Analysis Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities?
   

  

 Join our DTCC family, and you’ll grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll seek challenges with flexibility and patience, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.
   

  

**Why You Love This Job**
 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management
   

  

* Drive JIRA\-based Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization
* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status
* Ensure clear definition of acceptance criteria, test scope, and Definition of Done (DoD)
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates
* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks


 Resource Planning \& Workload Management
   

  

* Plan and allocate resources based on priority, complexity, and delivery timelines
* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively


 Metrics, Reporting \& Leadership Communication
   

  

* Prepare executive\-level dashboards, metrics, and status reports
* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines
* Present program updates to Director\-level and senior stakeholders
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making using tools such as Power BI / dashboards


 Process, Governance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EPPE testing standards, governance, and audit requirements
* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization
* Implement controls for traceability, test coverage, and compliance validation
* Support audit readiness and documentation standards


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Development teams
* Communicate risks, blockers, and status clearly and proactively
* Influence outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Infrastructure Testing, or Delivery/Program Coordination roles
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, automation pipelines
* Strong experience in Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban)
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)
* Experience working in infrastructure or platform environments (cloud/on\-prem)
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
