title: Consultant - Vault Safety
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Help us transform and bring innovation to Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance!
   

  

 Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance experts to join the Professional Services team and support implementations of our Vault Safety solution. We want innovative thinkers with deep domain expertise who are ready to challenge the status quo with new technology.
   

  

 As a key member of our Professional Services team, the Consultant \- Safety will work side\-by\-side with customers and our senior consultants and solution Architects to implement Vault Safety. In this role, the candidate will support the overall delivery of Vault Safety for our customers. They will define and drive business processes, support the project team in delivering the solution, and guide our customers throughout the implementation programs.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support life sciences customers in the rapid configuration and implementation of Vault Safety.
* Execute workshops and lead customer discussions of the Vault Development Cloud.
* Lead gap analyses, workshop preparation and delivery, requirements gathering, configuration, validation, and customer training.
* Gather customer functional and technical requirements to support business processes; translate requirements into system configuration.
* Provide subject matter expertise on Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance for customers and project teams.
* Represent Safety Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g. solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.).
* Ensure customer success from beginning to end of the engagement life cycle.
* Provide Argus / Aris data model expertise in migrating customers’ existing data into Vault safety.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function.
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations.
* Must have decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets.
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any homegrown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction.
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in previous employment.
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety.
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements.
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required.
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success.


****Nice to Have****
* Proven track record supporting high\-impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business or IT lead, and/or business sponsor.
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in service delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health Insurance fully covers the family, including Employee’s parents
* Work from anywhere culture which allows flexible work location
* Fitness benefits fully taken care by Veeva


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Field Application Engineer- Aerospace & Defense
description:
**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 At Emerson Test \& Measurement Business Group (Formerly known as National Instruments), we empower engineers and innovators to solve the world’s toughest engineering challenges through automated test and measurement solutions. Our platforms are widely used across Aerospace \& Defense, Semiconductor, Automotive, Communications, and Industrial markets to accelerate innovation and improve engineering productivity.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly motivated and technically strong Field Applications Engineer (FAE) to support and grow our Aerospace \& Defense business in India.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Field Applications Engineer (FAE) will play a critical role in driving technical engagement with Aerospace \& Defense customers by understanding customer challenges, architecting solutions, supporting evaluations, and enabling successful deployment of automated test and validation systems.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical depth, customer\-facing capability, and the ability to work closely with sales teams, system integrators, partners, and customer engineering organizations. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving complex engineering problems and translating technology into measurable customer outcomes.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Engage with Aerospace \& Defense customers to understand technical requirements and system\-level challenges
* Architect and demonstrate solutions for applications involving RF \& microwave, radar, electronic warfare, avionics, communications, embedded systems, HIL, and automated validation
* Support pre\-sales technical activities including customer presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, benchmarking, and proof\-of\-concepts
* Work closely with Account Managers to drive technical wins and accelerate business growth
* Collaborate with System Integrators and ecosystem partners to support scalable deployment models
* Design and recommend architectures using modular instrumentation, PXI platforms, automated test software, and validation frameworks
* Provide technical consultation on system integration, automation strategies, and test methodologies
* Support customer onboarding, implementation guidance, and technical issue resolution
* Work cross\-functionally with R\&D, product teams, services, and global application engineering teams
* Track emerging Aerospace \& Defense technology trends and customer requirements to influence future solution strategies


**Who You Are:**
 You are a proactive, strategic problem solver who establishes last relationships and delivers exceptional results. You’re comfortable managing complex accounts and driving account growth at both tactical and strategic levels.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is mandatory (Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Instrumentation, Aerospace, or related disciplines preferred)
* 6–10 years of experience in application engineering, systems engineering, validation, or technical consulting within Aerospace \& Defense or related industries
* Strong technical understanding of automated test and validation systems
* Experience with RF test, radar systems, avionics, embedded systems, communications, or HIL environments
* Ability to understand and architect complex system\-level solutions
* Strong customer\-facing communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with sales teams, customers, and partners
* Willingness to travel based on project and customer requirements
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with technical curiosity
* Ability to engage deeply with customer engineering teams
* Passion for solving real\-world engineering challenges
* Strong ownership and execution orientation
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into customer value
* Collaborative and high\-energy team player


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Prior experience with National Instruments / Emerson Test \& Measurement platforms will be a strong advantage
* Hands\-on experience with PXI, RF instrumentation, DAQ systems, or modular test platforms
* Experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, MATLAB, or automated test software frameworks
* Familiarity with Aerospace \& Defense validation workflows and integration environments
* Experience working with System Integrators or large defense programs is an added advantage

title: Generalist Intern - Research and Operations
description:
**Role:** 
 Generalist Intern \- Research and Operations
 



**Company:** 
 StepsAI
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time Internship
 



  





**About StepsAI** 




  





 StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses engage, sell, support, and automate customer conversations across websites, e\-commerce stores, WhatsApp, Instagram, and other digital channels.
 



 We are a fast\-moving team working across product, sales, marketing, customer success, partnerships, and operations.
 



  





 As we grow, we are looking for someone who can work closely with the founders and bring greater structure, visibility, and follow\-through across the organization.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Founder’s Office Intern will work directly with the founders on company\-wide planning, coordination, documentation, operations, and special projects.
 



  





 This is an execution\-oriented role.
 



  





 Your responsibility will be to help turn discussions and priorities into clear plans, keep important initiatives moving, and make sure founders and teams have visibility into what is happening across the company.
 



  





 You will work across functions rather than being limited to one department.
 



  





 A big part of your job will be answering three questions:
 



**What are we doing?** 




**Who owns it?** 




**What needs to happen next?** 




  





**What You’ll Own** 




  




 1\. Planning \& Project Coordination
 * Maintain visibility across important company initiatives and priorities.
* Convert discussions into clear action items, owners, and timelines.
* Track projects and follow up with relevant team members.
* Identify delays, dependencies, blockers, and unresolved items.
* Prepare weekly priority and progress updates for the founders.
* Help teams stay aligned on deadlines and commitments.
* Maintain a central view of ongoing initiatives.



  




 2\. Founder’s Office Operations
 * Support founders with day\-to\-day business coordination.
* Prepare agendas and context before important meetings.
* Capture decisions, action items, and responsibilities after meetings.
* Follow up on commitments until they are completed.
* Organize information the founders need for meetings and decisions.
* Coordinate with employees, candidates, customers, vendors, partners, and other stakeholders when required.



  




 3\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management
 * Create and maintain internal documentation.
* Document important decisions, processes, and workflows.
* Build and maintain SOPs.
* Organize company documents, meeting notes, trackers, and reports.
* Turn unstructured information into clear and usable documents.
* Make sure important information is easy for the team to find.



  




 4\. Reporting \& Operating Visibility
 * Maintain simple dashboards and trackers for important company initiatives.
* Collect updates from different teams.
* Summarize progress, upcoming priorities, blockers, and pending decisions.
* Help the founders quickly understand where different initiatives stand.
* Improve the way information moves across the company.



  





 The goal is not to create more reporting.
 



 The goal is to create
 **clarity** 
 .
 



  




 5\. Events \& Internal Initiatives
 * Help plan and execute company events, customer events, workshops, conferences, and team activities.
* Coordinate venues, vendors, schedules, attendees, materials, and logistics.
* Create event plans and checklists.
* Coordinate responsibilities across the team.
* Make sure everything is followed through before, during, and after an event.



  




 6\. Special Projects
 
  





 You will occasionally take ownership of projects that do not neatly belong to one department.
 



  





 Examples could include:
 


* Researching and evaluating a new tool or vendor.
* Creating a new internal process.
* Coordinating a product or campaign launch.
* Researching competitors or markets.
* Improving an existing company workflow.
* Setting up a new reporting system.
* Helping coordinate an important customer initiative.
* Supporting partnerships or company events.
* Solving an operational bottleneck.



  





 The expectation is that you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it, and help move it toward completion.
 



  




 7\. People \& Hiring Coordination
 
  





 When required, you may also help with:
 


* Maintaining hiring trackers.
* Coordinating interviews.
* Following up with candidates.
* Preparing onboarding plans.
* Coordinating new employee or intern onboarding.
* Organizing internal meetings and team activities.



  




 What We’re Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who is:
 



  





 Highly organized
 



 You naturally bring structure to scattered information and multiple priorities.
 



  





 Strong at follow\-through
 



 You don't stop after documenting a task. You track it until there is an outcome.
 



  





 Proactive
 



 You identify what needs attention instead of waiting to be told every next step.
 



  





 Clear communicator
 



 You can turn a long discussion into a short, clear summary with decisions and next actions.
 



  





 Comfortable with ambiguity
 



 Not every problem will arrive with detailed instructions.
 



  





 Detail\-oriented
 



 Names, dates, numbers, deadlines, and commitments matter.
 



  





 Resourceful
 



 When you don't know something, you know how to figure it out.
 



  





 Comfortable working across teams
 



 You should be able to coordinate with product, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership.
 



  





 Reliable and discreet
 



 You may work with confidential company information and founder\-level discussions.
   




 Who Should Apply
 
  





 This role could be a strong fit if you are:
 


* A final\-year student or recent graduate.
* Interested in startups, entrepreneurship, operations, or business.
* Someone who has organized college clubs, festivals, communities, events, projects, or teams.
* Someone who enjoys making plans and making sure they actually happen.
* Comfortable taking responsibility beyond a narrowly defined job description.



  





 Previous startup experience is helpful but not required.
 



  





 We value
 **ownership, clarity, communication, and execution** 
 more than a specific degree.
   




 What Success Looks Like
 
  





 Within a few months, you should help create a situation where:
 


* Important projects have clear owners and timelines.
* Founders can quickly understand what is happening across the company.
* Meeting decisions are documented and followed through.
* Pending tasks don't disappear.
* Important blockers are surfaced early.
* Internal documentation is organized and current.
* Events and special projects have clear execution plans.
* Teams know what needs to happen next.



  





 You should gradually become a reliable source of
 **operating clarity** 
 for the founders.
   




 Why Join StepsAI
 
  





 This role gives you exposure to how an early\-stage AI company is actually built.
 



  





 You will work closely with the founders and get visibility across:
 


* Product
* AI
* Sales
* Marketing
* Customer success
* Operations
* Hiring
* Partnerships
* Strategy



  





 Rather than working on one narrow function, you will see how different parts of a startup come together and have the opportunity to take ownership of real projects.
 



  




* For someone who wants to eventually build a company, work in startups, enter business operations, or grow into a Founder’s Office / Chief of Staff role, this can be a strong learning opportunity.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and proactive individual to manage small projects end to end and to support Project Managers and Project Analysts in the day\-to\-day coordination, tracking and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) projects across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will independently run small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives using the team's SWAT and Transition frameworks, while acting as the operational backbone of the Projects team – keeping plans, trackers, action logs and evidence current; scheduling and minuting governance forums; chasing actions to closure; and ensuring the team's tools and templates are consistently used. This is an individual contributor role in the Projects team with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects, and is the foundation for a career in project and programme management at Alter Domus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Small Project Management**
* Independently manage small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives (e.g. single\-team process changes, small work transfers or Transition Lite items, tooling or reporting roll\-outs, remediation actions) from kick\-off to closure, applying the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks proportionately
* Define scope, success criteria, timeline and stakeholders for small projects with the Business / CD Lead, publish a simple plan and run regular check\-points to drive the actions to completion
* Identify and log risks, issues and dependencies for own projects, resolve them at working level and escalate to the Head of Projects or a Project Manager where a decision or intervention is required
* Provide status updates on own projects into the team's weekly reporting and governance forums and complete closure and lessons\-learnt documentation


**Project Coordination \& Tracking**
* Maintain project plans, trackers and checklists for assigned projects – including the Transition Checklist, recruitment / onboarding tracker, access and IT tracker, training completion records and impacted\-teams register – ensuring they are accurate and up to date at all times
* Track actions, owners and due dates from all project meetings and proactively follow up with owners across Business, Tech, Client Delivery and cross\-functional teams to drive closure
* Support the Project Manager / Project Analyst in preparing detailed plans, timelines and milestone schedules and in updating them as the project evolves
* Own defined workstreams within larger Transition and Transformation projects under the guidance of a Project Manager


**Governance Forums \& Toll Gate Support**
* Organise and support governance forums – schedule Tier 2 (weekly) and Tier 3 (operational) meetings, bi\-weekly transition reviews and toll\-gate (TG1/TG2/TG3\) reviews; prepare agendas, circulate pre\-reads, capture minutes, decisions and actions and distribute them promptly
* Collect, file and index toll\-gate evidence (sign\-off emails, approved plans, acceptance forms, training and access confirmations) in the designated SharePoint / Confluence locations and keep the evidence checklist current
* Chase pending sign\-offs from LoB, CD Leads, GPOs, Academy, IT and Control Tower ahead of toll\-gate dates and flag anything at risk to the Project Manager
* Maintain the decision log and action log for assigned projects


**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Logging**
* Capture risks, issues and dependencies raised in meetings and by stakeholders into the RAID log with clear descriptions, owners and target dates
* Monitor open items for ageing and overdue status and highlight them to the Project Manager / Project Analyst for escalation
* Support the preparation of escalation notes and mitigation trackers


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Prepare first drafts of status reports – weekly project updates, the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update and governance packs – by collecting inputs from Project Managers, Tech PMO and stakeholders and populating the standard templates
* Update KPI trackers and dashboards (hiring progress, onboarding, training completion, KC/KT scorecards, milestone status) with validated data from source teams
* Maintain project documentation – charters, stakeholder lists, RACI, communication plans, SOP / process documentation packs received from LoBs – with correct version control
* Ensure all project artefacts are stored in the agreed structure on SharePoint / Confluence and are easy for stakeholders to find


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for routine queries, data requests and scheduling across global delivery locations and time zones
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams – Talent Acquisition, Academy (KC/KT), IT / Access, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Facilities and Control Tower – to obtain inputs and confirm completion of their actions
* Draft clear and professional meeting invites, minutes, follow\-up notes and status communications for review by the Project Manager
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and represent the Projects team professionally


**Tools, Templates \& PMO Administration**
* Administer Jira boards, Confluence spaces and SharePoint libraries for assigned projects – creating and updating items, maintaining workflows and access lists and ensuring data hygiene
* Apply the team's standard templates (Transition Acceptance Document, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates, status report and RAID templates) and suggest practical improvements based on usage
* Support onboarding of new project stakeholders to the team's tools and ways of working
* Support post\-project reviews by collating feedback, lessons learnt and closure documentation


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations or related field
* Project management foundation certification (CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile / Scrum fundamentals) or willingness to obtain within the first year
* Overall 3\-7 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 2\-5 years of project coordination and execution experience – supporting or running projects, workstreams or process changes in a project, PMO or operations role
* Exposure to transitions, process migrations, change initiatives or working with global / multi\-location teams an advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups, basic charts), PowerPoint and Outlook; exposure to Power BI an advantage
* Working knowledge of collaboration and project tools – SharePoint, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence or equivalent
* Familiarity with basic project management concepts – plans, milestones, RAID logs, action tracking, minutes


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead
description:
****About Carrier****
**Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.**
****About This Role / Job Summary****
**The Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead will enable, maintain, test, adopt, and govern supplier catalogs within SAP Ariba. The role will manage supplier catalog onboarding, PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalog implementation, catalog configuration and troubleshooting, UAT and go\-live readiness, catalog adoption reporting, and stakeholder coordination with Procurement Operations, Supplier Management, Category Managers, AMS, Digital, IT, and suppliers.**
****Key Responsibilities****
**Supplier Catalog Enablement**
* Support supplier onboarding and enablement into the SAP Ariba catalog environment, including supplier Ariba Network relationship setup and registration coordination.
* Manage catalog implementation projects across categories and regions for PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalogs.
* Coordinate with suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data teams to resolve missing information and enable go\-live readiness.
* Maintain implementation trackers, action logs, risks, dependencies, and escalation visibility.


**Catalog Configuration, Administration \& Issue Resolution**
* Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.
* Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.
* Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.


**Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support**
* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go\-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.


**Catalog Adoption, Reporting \& Governance**
* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.


****Required Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4\+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue\-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project\-tracking skills.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared\-services model supporting multi\-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.


**Success Measures / KPIs**
* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On\-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go\-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non\-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.


**Key Stakeholders**
* Procurement Operations and Global SCM CoE
* Category Management and Regional Procurement teams
* Digital / IT / SAP Ariba support teams
* Supplier Enablement, Master Data, Contracts, and Suppliers
* Business requesters and approvers across global regions

description:

title: Scientist IV, Documentary Standards
description:
**Description**
 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 This is a hands\-on, non\-supervisory scientific position in the Global Biologics. The incumbent is responsible for providing support for the development of USP documentary standards and reference standards for biological products such as Peptides, Oligonucleotides, Proteins, Carbohydrates, Complex Biologics, Vaccines, Antibiotics, and Advanced Therapies etc. The incumbent will provide quality and technical review of scientific documents for accuracy, clarity and compliance, manage and track reference standard stability program and organize efforts for continuous process improvements. The incumbent will also focus on supporting the reference standard suitability program, including preparing and reviewing CSU testing protocols, providing technical assistance to testing labs, reviewing analytical data and preparing summary reports for confirming the continued suitability of USP Reference Standards (RS). The incumbent needs to be excellent team player with good collaboration/liaising skills to complete assigned projects in time\-bound manner.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Scientist \-IV (Reviewer) Has The Following Responsibilities**
 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Performs technical and quality reviews of documents to ensure a high level of document quality and compliance before QA review
* Manages and tracks efforts for continuous process improvements.
* Develops and reviews SOP’s, Operation Manuals, and training documents.
* Assists in investigations of quality related issues resulting from customer complaints to include root cause analysis, corrective action identification, action planning, and implementation monitoring.
* Works with internal stakeholders to develop new and innovative standards for analytical analysis of biological products.
* Communicates and maintains working relationships with cross functional USP departments regarding assigned projects
* Supports day\-to\-day operations of the RS Stability (CSU) program covering the USP Biologics RS catalog inventory.
* Reviews RS testing history and drafts test protocols for CSU studies and submits to labs based on designated testing requirements and schedules.
* Liaisons and Assists laboratories to ensure CSU testing is completed as per protocol and in timely manner.
* Reviews laboratory reports, evaluates results and compares previous data and RS attributes to assess and conclude on RS suitability for use.
* Compiles, assess current and historical stability testing data and prepare stability trend reports in a time\-bound manner.
* Support the maintenance and updating various databases documenting laboratory data and program determinations on suitability and Stability interval updates.
* Filing and closure of QMS elements as per QMS system when required and supports the RS Laboratory, Supporting Quality Assurance and Reference Standard Evaluation in the investigation of unexpected stability testing results
* Works collaboratively with various USP departments as needed on test planning, data impact assessments and appropriate determination of next steps.
* Prepare, present and discuss regular work updates with Team Lead and other team members


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

**Scientist IV (Reviewer)**
* Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry/Biological Science/Pharmaceutical Science, or a related field with a minimum of 3 to 5 years of commensurate industrial experience, or Master’s degree in Biochemistry/Biological Science/Pharmaceutical Science or a related field with 8 to10 years of commensurate industrial experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience in Technical review of analytical documents in Quality Assurance.
* Hands\-on experience with state\-of\-the\-art analytical techniques for the characterization of recombinant therapeutic proteins, peptides, gene therapy, vaccines and carbohydrates, such as UPLC/HPLC, LC\-MS, CD, Fluorescence spectroscopy, FTIR, DSC, SEC\-MALS, CE\-SDS (Reducing and Non\-reducing), icIEF, ELISA, SPR, ddPCR/qPCR etc.
* Strong ability to evaluate and compile analytical testing data, ability to write technical reports related to material characterization, references standard evaluations, and method development.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method development, method qualification/validation and characterization of biological products and impurities using a variety of physicochemical techniques and biological assays.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation and oral communication skills are required.
* Must be excellent team player and able to work amicably and communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Knowledge of USP products and services is highly desirable.
* Operates collaboratively at all levels of the organization in a highly technical environment.
* Must be able to work in a fast\-paced environment and respond to shifting priorities.
* Well\-developed interpersonal, negotiation, conflict\-resolution and listening skills.
* Must possess the ability to multi\-task and to work effectively with a team.
* Takes ownership and personal responsibility to ensure work is delivered on time and is of the highest possible quality.
* Experience working in the compendial, pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry strongly preferred.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 None, this is an individual contributor role.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Chemistry \& Scientific Standards
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Role: Regulatory AI \& Automation Specialist
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Job Type: Full Time
   

  

 Years of Experience: 4–6 years
   

  

 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
   

  

 That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 Mission
   

  

 Roche Services \& Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever\-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end\-to\-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient\-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai \& Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer\-centric 24/7 and co\-create solutions together.
   

  

 The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end\-to\-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company\-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
   

  

 Your Opportunity
   

  

 As a Regulatory AI \& Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands\-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI\-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high\-value use cases for regulatory document workflows
* Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low\-Code/No\-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud\-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.
* Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation \& Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high\-impact AI and automation opportunities
* Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical \& preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production
* Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution architecture, source code repositories, and testing frameworks) and conduct hands\-on internal training to empower business teams and drive adoption across global regulatory functions
* Drive cross\-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation \& Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
* Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders
* Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency


 Who You Are
   

  

 You are a hands\-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R\&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem\-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production\-ready AI tools.
   

  

 Qualifications \& Technical Skillset:
   

  

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands\-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
* Education \& Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R\&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
* Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi\-agent orchestration
* Core Programming \& Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production\-ready code
* Document AI \& Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word)
* AI \& LLM Integration: Hands\-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying
* Software Engineering \& APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices
* Workflow \& Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low\-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers
* Exposure to Deployment \& Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services


 Strong to have:
   

  

* Prompt Architecture \& Validation: Ability to design complex, multi\-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively
* Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance


 Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs.
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:

title: Incident Commander
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 The Incident Commander is a senior cybersecurity communications role responsible for leading stakeholder communication, coordination, and reporting during significant security incidents across Cubic. Working alongside the technical response lead, this person ensures updates to executives, customers, legal, compliance, and other key stakeholders are timely, accurate, and aligned with regulatory obligations, while also helping strengthen incident readiness through exercises, templates, and post\-incident reviews.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
 The responsibilities below provide a high\-level view of what this role is expected to do and are intended to help external candidates quickly understand the scope of the position.
   

  

* Lead the coordination of communications and stakeholder engagement during significant cybersecurity incidents, ensuring information is shared clearly, consistently, and at the right level for each audience.
* Partner closely with technical incident responders and security leaders to understand developing events, assess business impact, and translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable updates.
* Prepare and deliver timely status updates, briefings, and situational reports for executives, internal business teams, customers, and other stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, privacy, and business leaders to ensure incident communications are appropriate, accurate, and aligned with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
* Maintain accurate incident records, timelines, decisions, and communication logs so that key actions, updates, and outcomes are well documented during and after an event.
* Support customer and externally facing communication needs when incidents affect services, contractual obligations, or reporting expectations, helping ensure messaging is professional and consistent.
* Help drive incident readiness by maintaining communication templates, stakeholder contact information, notification processes, and other materials needed to support effective response.
* Participate in and help coordinate incident response exercises, simulations, and readiness activities that improve communication effectiveness and strengthen organizational preparedness.
* Contribute to post\-incident reviews, executive summaries, and follow\-up improvement actions by helping capture lessons learned and identify opportunities to enhance future response efforts.
* Provide escalation support and executive\-ready communications during high\-severity or high\-visibility incidents, often under tight timelines and changing conditions.
* Build strong working relationships across cybersecurity, IT, legal, compliance, customer\-facing teams, and business leadership to enable effective collaboration during complex incidents.
* Operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment, maintaining sound judgment, attention to detail, and professionalism while supporting incidents that may require after\-hours engagement or on\-call participation.


 General Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Able to operate in a professional manner, even in tense or continuous settings.
* Able to reliably demonstrate ethical behavior and accurate communications even when complex factors are involved.
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic’s quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company’s strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Essential**
 Minimum Job Qualifications
   

  

* The candidate must reside within commuting distance from the Cubic office in Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, and be able to periodically travel within the region.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or Business Administration with relevant IT security experience; or equivalent professional experience at a commensurate level.
* A minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years with a Master’s degree; or equivalent work experience.
* A minimum of 5 years of hands\-on experience in cybersecurity incident response, crisis communications, security operations, or a directly related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder situations under time pressure, with the ability to produce accurate, clear, and concise written communications rapidly in high\-stress incident conditions.
* Experience working in crisis communications, and working with communications to executive staff, legal and law enforcement, and external government officials. Experience needs to include work with North America and/or European jurisdictions.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English; strong analytical judgment and the ability to work effectively with executive leadership, legal counsel, technical engineers, and external stakeholders.
* Direct familiarity with ISO 27001 and PCI DSS incident response requirements or documented equivalent regulatory communications experience in a comparable regulated environment.
* Highly desired to familiarity with Incident Command System (ICS) Communication Hierarchy principles, NIST SP 800\-61 Incident Response Communications, and/or Situational Crisis Communication Theory (SCCT).
* Experience running Disaster Recovery and Incident Response tabletop exercises.


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Experience with ITIL\-based incident management processes.
* Familiarity with Incident Command System / National Incident Management System (ICS/NIMS) communication principles.
* Crisis communications or public relations experience, particularly in a legal or regulatory environment.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as payment processing, defense contracting, healthcare, or financial services.
* Knowledge of or willingness to develop familiarity with relevant security and operational technologies including Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud environments, ITSM/ServiceNow, SIEM platforms (Splunk), and enterprise GRC tools (OneTrust).
* Wide\-ranging experience with in\-depth professional knowledge; capable of independently determining methods and procedures on new assignments, exercising judgment in selecting and adapting complex techniques, and producing results that may impact the entire security function. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise; uses persuasion in delivering messages that relate to the wider business. May be accountable through team for delivery of tactical business targets.
* Demonstrated experience developing or mentoring junior team members and managing a security exercise or communications training program.


 Condition of Employment
   

  

 Successful outcome of a National Police Check.

 Employee

title: Content Creator — Learning & Development
description:
**Role Summary** 




 You will build everything the trainers teach. That means the material for the 5 trainer\-led hours, the case packs managers use for the 2 practice hours, the self\-paced module on the LMS, and the tests we run before and after. The one thing only you can do: you decide how it gets taught. That is the value of this seat. The trainer tells you what the problem is and what the training must cover. You decide the rest — which real situation to use, which practice activity, which example, how the test is built. A vague need comes in from the trainer. Something that actually teaches goes out. This is not typing up someone's notes. When the 30\-day check says the work did not change, you rewrite it. Our content has to work at four levels — the common NIAT standard, the role track, the campus\-specific piece, and the single module given to one person for their own gap. Everything is taught remotely, so the material has to hold attention over video and also make sense on its own when nobody is teaching it. The hard part is how we judge this work. Content here is not judged on whether the deck looked good. It is judged on whether people worked differently afterwards, checked on a real sampled case.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Start from the trainer's brief — The trainer hands you the problem, the topic and what a person must be able to do at the end. That is your starting point every time. If the brief is thin, go back and ask. Do not guess.
 



 ● Decide how it will be taught — This is your call. Pick the real situation the session is built around. Pick the practice activity. Pick the example. Decide what people do in the room, not just what they hear. Sit in classes, listen to recorded calls and read tickets yourself so the examples are real ones.
 



 ● Build the trainer\-led material — Write the content for the 5 trainer\-led hours, made for remote teaching, in a form a trainer can pick up and run.
 



 ● Build the manager practice packs — Write the 2\-hour practice packs that a line manager, not a trainer, has to run with their own team. These have to work in the hands of someone who has never trained anyone.
 



 ● Build the self\-paced module — Every taught module also exists as recorded content. This is what lets the self\-paced hour run for \~900 people without adding trainers.
 



 ● Load the content into the platform yourself — You made it, so you put it in. Keep it tidy and keep the versions straight. Pulling reports back out is the Coordinator's job, not yours. TO CONFIRM: LMS — repurpose the existing learner product, or use something light like Notion. Not yet decided, no request raised. Build the content so it can move to either one without being rewritten from scratch.
 



 ● Write the tests, before and after — Build the check we run before training to size the gap, and the check we run after training to see whether the person can now do the work. The after check tests ability, not attendance. Build it at the same time as the module, not weeks later. There is no baseline today, so building one we can defend is the first piece of work.
 



 ● Set the rule for the individual module — Decide which module a person gets when a test shows a particular gap, so nobody has to sort this by hand.
 



 ● Make a campus version — Produce the campus\-level version of the material, because one common programme will not work across 40 campuses.
 



 ● Fix the content when the follow\-up says it did not work — When the 30\-day check shows the work did not change, that is a content problem as much as a training one. Find the weak part, rewrite it, and put the new version into the next cycle.
 



 ● Rebuild from what comes back — Take what trainers and managers report and fix the weak parts every cycle. Go and ask the most junior person in the system directly, instead of waiting for feedback to climb three levels.
 



 ● Use AI where it helps — Use AI for first drafts, question banks and pulling themes out of recordings. The call on what to teach stays with a person. We are not making this content AI\-first.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 ● Has written training or teaching material that somebody else taught from, and can show the pack that person was handed.
 



 ● Has built material for a non\-trainer to run — a teacher's guide, a manager's discussion pack — and can say what they changed to make it work in those hands.
 



 ● Has built tests, seen the results come back, and rewritten the test because of what the results showed.
 



 ● Has put content on an LMS or a learning platform and can say what made people finish it or drop it.
 



 ● Has built content by watching the actual work — sitting in a class, listening to calls, reading tickets — not from a written brief alone.
 



 ● Has made the same content in several versions for different groups, and can explain what changed between them.
 



 ● Has worked to a fixed monthly calendar where the content had to be finished before the session, not during it.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 ● Has made video or recorded content.
 



 ● Knows Telugu or Hindi in addition to English.
 



  





**Growth Path** 




 Next designation: Senior Content Creator (Level 2\). You earn it when other people teach from your material and it works in their hands, and the 30\-day check holds for three cycles in a row.
 



 Compensation

title: Product Application Engineer - Debug
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD\-AECG is an adaptable, self\-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next\-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. Technical Marketing works closely with Product Planning, R\&D, Applications Engineering, and top\-tier customers to improve the FPGA and Adaptive SoC design process and enable next\-generation designs and methodologies. The environment is fast\-moving, global, and focused on emerging technologies.
   

  

 THE PERSON
   

  

 The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting Programming File Generation and Hardware Debug in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes driving the programming file generation flow and the in\-system debug experience through Vivado Hardware Manager, Integrated Logic Analyzer (ILA), Virtual I/O (VIO), and readback/verification.
   

  

 This person understands customer needs and pain points across bring\-up and silicon debug, and helps define the next generation of the tool roadmap. The ability to manage competing priorities is essential. We operate with an agentic, AI\-first mindset and expect team members to actively incorporate AI into how they work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define best\-in\-class programming file generation and hardware debug flows, features, and methodologies for AMD FPGA, Zynq, and Adaptive SoC tools and libraries.
* Drive the programming file generation flow and in\-system debug capabilities, including Hardware Manager, ILA, VIO, and readback, from specification through validation.
* Lead field escalation response for critical debug and programming tool failures in production environments.
* Own toolchain integration with third\-party development and production test environments.
* Collaborate with R\&D on new device support and bring\-up validation for debug and programming tools.
* Partner with Engineering, Sales, Planning, and Customers to define and deliver tool features.
* Provide technical expertise to the field and customers through training materials, tutorials, and user guides, and mentor Field Applications Engineers.
* Communicate complex topics clearly to field teams and customers, including options, tradeoffs, and impact.
* Evaluate field and customer feedback, identify high\-priority feature gaps and improvements, and work with Planning and Engineering to drive fixes.


**Preferred Experience**
* Strong knowledge of the full FPGA design process and tool flow.
* Working knowledge of programming file generation and in\-system hardware debug flows, including ILA/VIO and readback, or similar methodologies.
* Experience with field escalations, toolchain integration, and production test environments.
* Expertise in system\-on\-chip development.
* Experience applying AI/ML tools and techniques, such as AI\-assisted design, debug, automation, or agentic workflows.
* Ability to analyze and solve complex system\-level issues, independently and in collaboration with top\-tier customers.
* Excellent written communication and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global teams

It is ideal for a change professional who enjoys both crafting the underlying approach and rolling up their sleeves on delivery.
 



 You will work alongside the Practice Lead and cross\-functional consulting teams on life sciences transformation programmes, contributing across the full spectrum of organisational change management — stakeholder engagement, communications, learning and enablement, change impact assessment, and adoption. As one of the foundational hires in the practice, you will have excellent scope to shape how we work and to grow with the practice as it scales.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Build change management assets, methodology, and approach** 



* **Develop reusable change assets —** 
 templates, playbooks, toolkits, and accelerators for stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, communications, training, and adoption measurement — that raise the quality and consistency of delivery across engagements.
* **Codify the practice methodology —** 
 help shape a scalable, repeatable change management framework and operating approach that can be tailored to different clients and programme types.
* **Contribute to practice IP —** 
 capture lessons learned, case studies, and benchmarks, and help build the knowledge base that differentiates Chryselys in the market.



**Support client delivery** 



* **Deliver change workstreams —** 
 support the design and execution of change management plans on client programmes, working within blended Chryselys and client teams.
* **Assess change impact and readiness —** 
 conduct stakeholder and change impact analyses, readiness assessments, and adoption tracking, translating findings into practical interventions.
* **Engage stakeholders —** 
 help plan and facilitate workshops, focus groups, and stakeholder sessions, and manage relationships with client counterparts at working and management levels.



**Communications, learning, and enablement** 



* **Craft communications —** 
 develop clear, audience\-appropriate change communications, messaging, and engagement materials across multiple channels and stakeholder groups.
* **Design learning and enablement —** 
 contribute to training needs analysis, and the design and delivery of learning materials, quick\-reference guides, and enablement content that drive user adoption.
* **Champion adoption —** 
 design and monitor adoption measures, feedback loops, and reinforcement mechanisms to embed new ways of working.



**Project management and governance** 



* **Manage change activities —** 
 plan, track, and report on change workstream activities, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies against programme timelines.
* **Support governance —** 
 maintain plans, RAID logs, decision logs, and status reporting, and prepare materials for steering and governance forums.
* **Coordinate across workstreams —** 
 work closely with programme, data, and technology teams to align change activity with the broader transformation.



**Experience and Qualifications** 




**Essential** 



* **4–8 years' experience** 
 in change management, organisational change, transformation, or a closely related discipline (change communications, learning and development, organisational design, or transformation project management).
* **Life sciences exposure —** 
 experience working with, or within, pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, or broader life sciences organisations.
* **Hands\-on change delivery —** 
 a demonstrable track record across the core change disciplines: stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, training and enablement, and adoption.
* **Strong communication skills —** 
 excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to produce polished client\-ready materials and to engage stakeholders with confidence.
* **Bachelor's degree** 
 or equivalent in a relevant discipline.



**Desirable**

 Prosci / ADKAR, APMG Change Management, CCMP, or equivalent.
* **Project management credentials —** 
 PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar.

 with commercial, medical affairs, or data transformations in life sciences (e.g. CRM, master data management, data platforms, or new operating models).

 confident with PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools; familiarity with survey, analytics, or change\-adoption tools is a plus.
* **Consulting background —** 
 experience delivering in a professional services, consulting, or advisory environment, ideally on transformation or change programmes.



**What You Bring** 



* A builder's mindset — comfortable creating structure, tools, and assets where none yet exist.
